Sentence (English): At the end of December 2025, we confidently replaced our old Bosch dishwasher (SGS55M02FF), purchased in 2005 and which had served us perfectly for 20 years, with a new Bosch dishwasher, and we are very disappointed.
Comments (English): [ Disappointment ] || ---------------- || At the end of December 2025, we confidently replaced our old Bosch dishwasher (SGS55M02FF), purchased in 2005 and which had served us perfectly for 20 years, with a new Bosch dishwasher, and we are very disappointed. Using the "automatic" wash cycle, as with our old appliance, we find that the dishes are not completely clean and, more importantly, are still damp when they come out of the dishwasher. We have to finish drying them with a dish towel before putting them away. Our new €900 model is even called "Perfectdry."
Comments (Original): [ Déception ] || ---------------- || Nous avons remplacé fin décembre 2025  en toute confiance notre ancien lave-vaisselle Bosch acheté en 2005 ( SGS55M02FF) et qui a donné pendant 20 ans toute satifaction  par un nouveau lave-vaisselle Bosch et nous sommes  très déçus: en utilisant le mode 'automatique' de lavage comme sur notre ancien appareil, nous constatons que la vaisselle n'est pas complètement propre et surtout elle est encore humide au sortir du lave-vaisselle. Nous devons  finir de sécher  au torchon de vaisselle la vaisselle avant de la ranger. Notre nouveau modèle  à 900 euros s'appelle pourtant 'Perfectdry'.

Sentence (English): Installed about a month ago as part of a kitchen remodel, replacing 20-year-old Kitchen Aid.
Comments (English): [ Innovative and adjustable racks ] || ---------------- || Installed about a month ago as part of a kitchen remodel, replacing 20-year-old Kitchen Aid. Back when KA (Hobart) was independent before being bought by Whirlpool, it made its reputation on two products: dishwashers and their iconic countertop mixer. The old KA model was as reliable and simple as a wood stove and did a great job. So far, this new model is continuing in that vein had some nice innovations, but takes longer to complete a normal cycle.After one month of use these observations: (1) It's very quiet and almost impossible to hear when running. (2) The third upper rack is innovative in its niches for coffee cups, small glasses, taller glasses and silverware. (3) The sensor-based ProWash cycle is a smart add since it adjusts the cycle length to the soil levels. (4) The exterior design is elegantly sleek and simple. (5) The handle and door open/close feel solid and substantial. (6) Cleaning quality is excellent with no residue or spots. (7) It's S-L-O-W. Unfortunately, due to government energy efficiency regulations, all modern dishwashers are much slower than older models. To gain efficiency they replace sheer force using lots of water with time and less water.

Comments (English): [ I switched from using a 6-person one. ! ] || ---------------- || After moving, I installed a dishwasher! I went from a 6-seater to a 14-seater, and the larger capacity is definitely more convenient! I use the dishwasher once a day after three meals for my family of three. ^^. Reasons for choosing this dishwasher: When I rented, I used a 6-seater dishwasher on the island. It was too small and took up too much counter space, leaving me with limited cooking space. There were a lot of other inconveniences, so I decided to get a built-in, large-capacity dishwasher (14-seater) for my move! This dishwasher offered the best value for money. Being an LG brand, its ease of use and after-sales service were its biggest selling points. Coupang was the best price, so I ordered it. I was very satisfied with the on-site installation. The convenience of setting a delivery date was fantastic! - I could set my preferred delivery and installation date when ordering. - If I needed to change my schedule at a moment's notice, I could change it right away (just click on the Coupang app!). - Installation was also convenient, as it was possible to schedule it 2-3 weeks ahead of my moving date. ^^ The installer was incredibly friendly and professional! - A professional LG technician came and personally installed the appliance. - From the initial phone call, he was exceptionally friendly. On the actual installation day, he treated the appliances as if they were his own, being extremely attentive and careful. - I was really worried about moving my kitchen cabinets, but he came to check my kitchen condition and provided a thorough consultation. He gave me an immediate solution. Thanks to him, I've been able to keep the cabinets I removed in the utility room and use them well. I'm very satisfied with the cost. It was the lowest price compared to other sites. - Prices fluctuate, but there was a time when they were the cheapest, so I ordered at that price and am very satisfied. - Coupang was the cheapest compared to other sites. The 5-year warranty for just 10,000 won was great. - I ordered both products because they offer a 5-year warranty for a small additional fee. - Since other sites don't offer this service, I applied for both products just in case. I liked the detailed information about additional costs! - There was a detailed guide to additional costs on the details page, so I read it carefully in advance~. - It really goes as planned^^ It was clean and clear without any questions. - I only moved the market, and the additional cost was 30,000 won, so it was clean and clear. It's a 10% rebate appliance! - Since it's a 10% rebate appliance, I can get a refund on the amount. I made a much more economical purchase^^. I'm very satisfied with the product. It's easy and simple to use~! - The technician explained how to use it from start to finish. - I'm using it as is, and it's very easy to use^^. - I use the AI auto-cleaning function the most, and it's convenient because it adjusts automatically~. There are no water stains when I use conditioner and salt^^. - When I use a 6-person dishwasher, there were always water stains on the glass dishes. I was worried about how to fix this. - The 14-person dishwasher is definitely larger, so there are compartments for conditioner and salt, etc., so the area to manage has expanded~~. - So, I used it by adding conditioner and salt as the technician instructed. It washes glassware well without leaving water marks. I use it once a day for three meals a day for a family of three. - The most satisfying thing is that it has a really large capacity! - Even after eating three home-cooked meals on the weekend. The capacity is enough to just run it once in the evening. The stress of washing dishes has been reduced. - There is nothing that cannot be put in, such as pots, stainless steel frying pans, large bowls, etc. You can put everything in and run it at once. It is very convenient. ^^. Note. If you are moving, I recommend installing it in advance~! When moving, construction dust can fly around. I recommend doing it before the move-in cleaning. Don't throw away the moved items, but use them in the utility room. ^^ - Coupang sells just the countertops separately. - If you buy them in the right size and use them, you can save storage space. I recommend moving the moved items to the utility room and using them well. ===========. Oh my, I'm so glad I changed it! It doesn't take up any space on the kitchen counter. It's large enough for 14 people, so it's great because it holds a lot. It also reduces the burden of washing dishes. It makes kitchen life so much more enjoyable.

There were a lot of other inconveniences, so I decided to get a built-in, large-capacity dishwasher (14-seater) for my move! This dishwasher offered the best value for money. He gave me an immediate solution. Thanks to him, I've been able to keep the cabinets I removed in the utility room and use them well. I'm very satisfied with the cost. It was the lowest price compared to other sites. - Prices fluctuate, but there was a time when they were the cheapest, so I ordered at that price and am very satisfied. - Coupang was the cheapest compared to other sites. The 5-year warranty for just 10,000 won was great. - I ordered both products because they offer a 5-year warranty for a small additional fee. - Since other sites don't offer this service, I applied for both products just in case. I liked the detailed information about additional costs! - There was a detailed guide to additional costs on the details page, so I read it carefully in advance~. - It really goes as planned^^ It was clean and clear without any questions. - I only moved the market, and the additional cost was 30,000 won, so it was clean and clear. It's a 10% rebate appliance! - Since it's a 10% rebate appliance, I can get a refund on the amount. I made a much more economical purchase^^. I'm very satisfied with the product. It's easy and simple to use~! - The technician explained how to use it from start to finish. - I'm using it as is, and it's very easy to use^^. - I use the AI auto-cleaning function the most, and it's convenient because it adjusts automatically~. There are no water stains when I use conditioner and salt^^. - When I use a 6-person dishwasher, there were always water stains on the glass dishes. I was worried about how to fix this. - The 14-person dishwasher is definitely larger, so there are compartments for conditioner and salt, etc., so the area to manage has expanded~~. - So, I used it by adding conditioner and salt as the technician instructed. It washes glassware well without leaving water marks. I use it once a day for three meals a day for a family of three. - The most satisfying thing is that it has a really large capacity! - Even after eating three home-cooked meals on the weekend. The capacity is enough to just run it once in the evening. The stress of washing dishes has been reduced. - There is nothing that cannot be put in, such as pots, stainless steel frying pans, large bowls, etc. You can put everything in and run it at once. It is very convenient. ^^. Note. If you are moving, I recommend installing it in advance~! When moving, construction dust can fly around. I recommend doing it before the move-in cleaning. Don't throw away the moved items, but use them in the utility room. ^^ - Coupang sells just the countertops separately. - If you buy them in the right size and use them, you can save storage space. I recommend moving the moved items to the utility room and using them well. ===========. Oh my, I'm so glad I changed it! It doesn't take up any space on the kitchen counter. It's large enough for 14 people, so it's great because it holds a lot. It also reduces the burden of washing dishes. It makes kitchen life so much more enjoyable.

It was the lowest price compared to other sites. - Prices fluctuate, but there was a time when they were the cheapest, so I ordered at that price and am very satisfied. - Coupang was the cheapest compared to other sites. I use it once a day for three meals a day for a family of three. - The most satisfying thing is that it has a really large capacity! - Even after eating three home-cooked meals on the weekend. The capacity is enough to just run it once in the evening. Don't throw away the moved items, but use them in the utility room. ^^ - Coupang sells just the countertops separately. - If you buy them in the right size and use them, you can save storage space. I recommend moving the moved items to the utility room and using them well. ===========. Oh my, I'm so glad I changed it! It doesn't take up any space on the kitchen counter. It's large enough for 14 people, so it's great because it holds a lot. It also reduces the burden of washing dishes. It makes kitchen life so much more enjoyable.

Reasons for choosing this dishwasher: When I rented, I used a 6-seater dishwasher on the island. It was too small and took up too much counter space, leaving me with limited cooking space. There were a lot of other inconveniences, so I decided to get a built-in, large-capacity dishwasher (14-seater) for my move! This dishwasher offered the best value for money. Being an LG brand, its ease of use and after-sales service were its biggest selling points. Coupang was the best price, so I ordered it. I was very satisfied with the on-site installation. The convenience of setting a delivery date was fantastic! - I could set my preferred delivery and installation date when ordering. - If I needed to change my schedule at a moment's notice, I could change it right away (just click on the Coupang app!). - Installation was also convenient, as it was possible to schedule it 2-3 weeks ahead of my moving date. ^^ The installer was incredibly friendly and professional! - A professional LG technician came and personally installed the appliance. - From the initial phone call, he was exceptionally friendly. On the actual installation day, he treated the appliances as if they were his own, being extremely attentive and careful. - I was really worried about moving my kitchen cabinets, but he came to check my kitchen condition and provided a thorough consultation. He gave me an immediate solution. Thanks to him, I've been able to keep the cabinets I removed in the utility room and use them well. I'm very satisfied with the cost. It was the lowest price compared to other sites. - Prices fluctuate, but there was a time when they were the cheapest, so I ordered at that price and am very satisfied. - Coupang was the cheapest compared to other sites. The 5-year warranty for just 10,000 won was great. - I ordered both products because they offer a 5-year warranty for a small additional fee. - Since other sites don't offer this service, I applied for both products just in case. I liked the detailed information about additional costs! - There was a detailed guide to additional costs on the details page, so I read it carefully in advance~. - It really goes as planned^^ It was clean and clear without any questions. - I only moved the market, and the additional cost was 30,000 won, so it was clean and clear. It's a 10% rebate appliance! - Since it's a 10% rebate appliance, I can get a refund on the amount. I made a much more economical purchase^^. I'm very satisfied with the product. It's easy and simple to use~! - The technician explained how to use it from start to finish. - I'm using it as is, and it's very easy to use^^. - I use the AI auto-cleaning function the most, and it's convenient because it adjusts automatically~. There are no water stains when I use conditioner and salt^^. - When I use a 6-person dishwasher, there were always water stains on the glass dishes. I was worried about how to fix this. - The 14-person dishwasher is definitely larger, so there are compartments for conditioner and salt, etc., so the area to manage has expanded~~. - So, I used it by adding conditioner and salt as the technician instructed. It washes glassware well without leaving water marks. I use it once a day for three meals a day for a family of three. - The most satisfying thing is that it has a really large capacity! - Even after eating three home-cooked meals on the weekend. The capacity is enough to just run it once in the evening. The stress of washing dishes has been reduced. - There is nothing that cannot be put in, such as pots, stainless steel frying pans, large bowls, etc. You can put everything in and run it at once. It is very convenient. ^^. Note. If you are moving, I recommend installing it in advance~! When moving, construction dust can fly around. I recommend doing it before the move-in cleaning. Don't throw away the moved items, but use them in the utility room. ^^ - Coupang sells just the countertops separately. - If you buy them in the right size and use them, you can save storage space. I recommend moving the moved items to the utility room and using them well. ===========. Oh my, I'm so glad I changed it! It doesn't take up any space on the kitchen counter. It's large enough for 14 people, so it's great because it holds a lot. It also reduces the burden of washing dishes. It makes kitchen life so much more enjoyable.

Comments (English): [ I switched from using a 6-person one. ! ] || ---------------- || After moving, I installed a dishwasher! I went from a 6-seater to a 14-seater, and the larger capacity is definitely more convenient! I use the dishwasher once a day after three meals for my family of three. ^^. Reasons for choosing this dishwasher: When I rented, I used a 6-seater dishwasher on the island. It was too small and took up too much counter space, leaving me with limited cooking space. There were a lot of other inconveniences, so I decided to get a built-in, large-capacity dishwasher (14-seater) for my move! This dishwasher offered the best value for money. Being an LG brand, its ease of use and after-sales service were its biggest selling points. Coupang was the best price, so I ordered it. I was very satisfied with the on-site installation. The convenience of setting a delivery date was fantastic! - I could set my preferred delivery and installation date when ordering. - If I needed to change my schedule at a moment's notice, I could change it right away (just click on the Coupang app!). - Installation was also convenient, as it was possible to schedule it 2-3 weeks ahead of my moving date. ^^ The installer was incredibly friendly and professional! - A professional LG technician came and personally installed the appliance. - From the initial phone call, he was exceptionally friendly. On the actual installation day, he treated the appliances as if they were his own, being extremely attentive and careful. - I was really worried about moving my kitchen cabinets, but he came to check my kitchen condition and provided a thorough consultation. He gave me an immediate solution. Thanks to him, I've been able to keep the cabinets I removed in the utility room and use them well. I'm very satisfied with the cost. It was the lowest price compared to other sites. - Prices fluctuate, but there was a time when they were the cheapest, so I ordered at that price and am very satisfied. - Coupang was the cheapest compared to other sites. The 5-year warranty for just 10,000 won was great. - I ordered both products because they offer a 5-year warranty for a small additional fee. - Since other sites don't offer this service, I applied for both products just in case. I liked the detailed information about additional costs! - There was a detailed guide to additional costs on the details page, so I read it carefully in advance~. - It really goes as planned^^ It was clean and clear without any questions. - I only moved the market, and the additional cost was 30,000 won, so it was clean and clear. It's a 10% rebate appliance! - Since it's a 10% rebate appliance, I can get a refund on the amount. I made a much more economical purchase^^. I'm very satisfied with the product. It's easy and simple to use~! - The technician explained how to use it from start to finish. - I'm using it as is, and it's very easy to use^^. - I use the AI auto-cleaning function the most, and it's convenient because it adjusts automatically~. There are no water stains when I use conditioner and salt^^. - When I use a 6-person dishwasher, there were always water stains on the glass dishes. I was worried about how to fix this. - The 14-person dishwasher is definitely larger, so there are compartments for conditioner and salt, etc., so the area to manage has expanded~~. - So, I used it by adding conditioner and salt as the technician instructed. It washes glassware well without leaving water marks. I use it once a day for three meals a day for a family of three. - The most satisfying thing is that it has a really large capacity! - Even after eating three home-cooked meals on the weekend. The capacity is enough to just run it once in the evening. The stress of washing dishes has been reduced. - There is nothing that cannot be put in, such as pots, stainless steel frying pans, large bowls, etc. You can put everything in and run it at once. It is very convenient. ^^. Note. If you are moving, I recommend installing it in advance~! When moving, construction dust can fly around. I recommend doing it before the move-in cleaning. Don't throw away the moved items, but use them in the utility room. ^^ - Coupang sells just the countertops separately. - If you buy them in the right size and use them, you can save storage space. I recommend moving the moved items to the utility room and using them well. ===========. Oh my, I'm so glad I changed it! It doesn't take up any space on the kitchen counter. It's large enough for 14 people, so it's great because it holds a lot. It also reduces the burden of washing dishes. It makes kitchen life so much more enjoyable.

Comments (English): [ Terrible machine, warranty, and support. ] || ---------------- || We purchased this machine at the end of 2022. Not even 3 years later the motor, which coincidentally has a 10-year warranty (I wonder why) failed. The faulty unit design allows for the pump seals/bearing to fail prematurely and allow water to get into the direct drive motor. The water intrusion destroys the motor and its game over. The motor/pump is extremely easy to remove, I'll give them that, but they will not warranty it to the customer. Instead you would need to get a technician out, who will charge you $300-350 for replacement for something that anyone with a Phillips screwdriver could replace in 5 minutes. I'm very mechanically inclined and I understand that some people aren't. If the cost of the motor wasn't over $300 and under $100, I wouldn't even warranty it out. I would have just replaced it myself. All I wanted is a replacement motor, guess that was too much. I suggest LG remove that giant 10-yr sticker from the unit because it's very misleading as well as the warranty document. The document states "Direct Drive Motor: Customer will be responsible for any labor OR in-home service to replace defective parts." Nowhere does it state that the labor needs to be by an LG technician. I will NEVER buy another LG product and I will warn my friends and family to stay away. Not only is the product terrible and unreliable, but their technical support doesn't care at all. Way to lose a customer LG, guess I'm going back to KitchenAid.

Sentence (English): Works well, until it doesn't.
Comments (English): [ Works well, until it doesn't due to design flaw ] || ---------------- || Works well, until it doesn't. The dishwasher had always been great for us. Relatively silent, low water consumption, dishes get clean without streaks as long as we find the right detergent (Molly's suds). And all things seem to be of good quality. The capacity is decent and the minimal design is attractive. It would be nice to have some smart things integration but I assume it's an extra feature on other models. Similar to other reviews i have read, our dishwasher failed us after 4 years. The problem is quite frustrating. The main dishwasher motor sits directly below the center of the unit and its shaft goes up into the dishwasher through a shaft seal washer. Part #DD62-00053A. This $10-40 part (depending where you buy it) is the only thing keeping water from coming down on to the motor. As you may have guessed, this part lasts 3-4 years until water will find its way down to the motor and start rusting components in it causing the motor to perform worse and worse until failure or a larger scale leak. The motor is $80-220 depending on where you get it as well. Buying the entire motor/sump assembly Part #DD82-01353A is the better value at $180-260 but at that point, you start to wonder whether a new dishwasher is better. So sadly this dishwasher, without knowing to replace the shaft seal washer will cost about $200 and removal/reinstall every 4 years OR $30 every 3 years on a new washer if you know to replace it. This could easily be a maintenance item Samsung recommends but I speculate selling new dishwashers is more the priority. If a Samsung rep sees this review, I urge you to be more transparent in conveying proactive maintenance steps which go beyond filter cleaning to your customers. I would have gladly paid a Samsung tech $150 to replace the cheap washer had I known than to have pulled the dishwasher out and found this all myself. If you an existing customer with this dishwasher, replace the motor shaft seal at 3 years or ASAP if you've had it longer. Repair clinic has a video on it. Very easy. If you are considering purchasing this dishwasher, just know what you're getting into. The dishwasher has been great for us for 4 years. until it wasn't. Just seams poor design to have a seal subject to wear be the main point of failure for the machine and not tell anybody about it.

Sentence (English): I had to buy a new dishwasher because my old one died.
Comments (English): [ Missing some useful features ] || ---------------- || I had to buy a new dishwasher because my old one died. I thought this one would be at least as good as my old GE appliance, but unfortunately it falls short. The top rack seems flimsy like it will not hold up long-term. The buttons on the top of the door are hard to see - I prefer seeing the buttons on the front. The only advantage is not accidentally turning on the dishwasher when leaning against it. The silverware rack is too large and takes up too much space on the bottom rack. Overall, the interior is actually smaller than my previous washer. Lastly, my old machine had a timer on the front that showed how much time was left in the cycle - this one doesn't and I really miss that feature! The good: dishes do get clean and it serves as a good drying rack for when I hand wash dishes. I would not buy this washer again and would look for something that feels sturdier and had the features I want.

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher 6 months ago, and have used it quite extensively.
Comments (English): [ "Touch buttons" a show stopper. ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher 6 months ago, and have used it quite extensively. While it seems to be durable, the "touch button" system is pretty bad. I miss the simple, firm toggle buttons of the old days. If your hands are cold/wet, the button does not recognize your finger on the on/off switch. If it's dark in the room, I can't just feel around for the on/off button. I have to precisely touch the button in the exact area. In addition, the buttons can be activated by brushing against them as you reach for a dish in the cabinet above the machine. If you accidentally brush against the on/off button, the machine restarts from the ***beginning of the cycle***. I have to put a chair in front to remind people not to go near the machine while it is washing! When I want to add dishes just after starting, I have to touch the start "button" to restart the machine. On our old Bosch, I could add dishes, close the door, and the machine would pick up where it left off. The racks inside are also not great for a variety of sizes. Pins on the racks that separate dishes are widely spaced and at funky angles. A small wine glass does not securely fit in the machine, so it has to be sandwiched between other dishes to prevent it from falling over. The pins fold down, which is a nice idea, but they fall over too easily. As far as noise, it is much louder than our old Bosch. More annoyingly, the machine plays some old sailor's tune when the wash is complete.

Sentence (English): Installed about a month ago as part of a kitchen remodel, replacing 20-year-old Kitchen Aid.
Comments (English): [ Innovative and adjustable racks ] || ---------------- || Installed about a month ago as part of a kitchen remodel, replacing 20-year-old Kitchen Aid. Back when KA (Hobart) was independent before being bought by Whirlpool, it made its reputation on two products: dishwashers and their iconic countertop mixer. The old KA model was as reliable and simple as a wood stove and did a great job. So far, this new model is continuing in that vein had some nice innovations, but takes longer to complete a normal cycle. After one month of use these observations: (1) It's very quiet and almost impossible to hear when running. (2) The third upper rack is innovative in its niches for coffee cups, small glasses, taller glasses and silverware. (3) The sensor-based ProWash cycle is a smart add since it adjusts the cycle length to the soil levels. (4) The exterior design is elegantly sleek and simple. (5) The handle and door open/close feel solid and substantial. (6) Cleaning quality is excellent with no residue or spots. (7) It's S-L-O-W. Unfortunately, due to government energy efficiency regulations, all modern dishwashers are much slower than older models. To gain efficiency they replace sheer force using lots of water with time and less water.

Sentence (English): As a dual-income couple, I used to sigh every time I saw the pile of dishes after work.
Comments (English): [ I like that there is no additional work to be done on the countertop. ] || ---------------- || As a dual-income couple, I used to sigh every time I saw the pile of dishes after work. But after much deliberation, the Samsung Bespoke countertop dishwasher has dramatically improved my quality of life! 1. Clean and bright Bespoke design. My kitchen is on the small side, so I was worried about installation, but the clean white design brightens the kitchen. Because it's a countertop model, it sits right on the sink, making installation a breeze. The intuitive front touch panel makes it easy for my parents to use, too. 2. Compact yet spacious. I expected it to be small for a six-person dishwasher, but the internal basket layout is incredibly efficient. As you can see in the photo, there's a separate cutlery holder, and I love the ample space for plates and large bowls. The three-dimensional cleaning effect of the lower spray arm and upper water jet is particularly impressive, ensuring a thorough clean in every nook and cranny. 3. Powerful sterilization and cleaning power. The most satisfying feature is the 99.999% sterilization certification! The high-temperature sterilization function means I can handle greasy dishes and baby dishes with confidence. The detergent dispenser is divided into compartments, making it easy to adjust the detergent, and the automatic door opening function after washing dries the dishwasher fluffy without worrying about moisture or odor. 4. Cost-effective and energy efficient. It also has a 3-star energy efficiency rating, and it uses less water than expected per wash, making it economical. It's also quiet, so you can leave it on at night without disturbing your sleep. Overall: I'm so satisfied that I wonder why I bought it now. This is a valuable product that allows me to have more conversations with my family while doing dishes. I highly recommend it to single-person households, newlyweds, and those with limited kitchen space!

Sentence (English): I had a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I was using it to store kitchenware.
Comments (English): I had a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I was using it to store kitchenware. Now, the door won't close at all. After much deliberation, I decided to buy a dishwasher. I used to always buy the latest model when buying electronics, but as I've gotten older, maintenance is more important than the product itself. I was looking for something that was faithful to the basic functions, was affordable, and wouldn't stand out when installed in my kitchen. I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. My existing dishwasher was 12-person, so I thought it would only work with 12-person models. However, the 12-person and 14-person models are the same size, so they're compatible. They say electronics are a case of "bigger is better" and "smaller", so I figured if the external dimensions of a 12-person and 14-person model were the same, the internal space would be more usable. So, I chose the 12-person model. The white color was sold out, but since the upper and lower kitchen cabinet doors are over a decade old, the Nature Beige dishwasher blends in perfectly, just like the original built-in appliance. I think if I had installed it in white, my cabinets would have looked even more yellowish. The day after I purchased it, I received a KakaoTalk message confirming it was ready for installation, and the day after that, it was installed. Installation took about an hour and ten minutes. The installer was very thorough, ensuring the level was perfect, and I wondered if the installer should charge extra for the installation. Since we were removing the existing built-in appliance and installing the new one, there was no additional cost. I use powdered detergent, and I've seen reviews of dishwashers that mention residue on the dishes, so I was worried. But there's no such issue. The dishwasher is so clean and the dishes are shiny, and I'm happy with it. My husband was worried that the dishwasher would use a lot of water, but I told him that it uses so little water that even countries with water shortages recommend installing it. It's a top-rated energy-efficient product, so it doesn't use much electricity, and I even got a 10% rebate if I bought it at the end of December. I couldn't have asked for a better option. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute program, which includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since I have a small family, the 1 hour program is more than enough. For families with young children, the sterilization and high-temperature drying program would be incredibly helpful and reassuring. It's been less than a few days since I installed it, and I'm already able to load all my dishes and do other household chores. It's so convenient, I wish I hadn't been so stubborn and bought it sooner. I hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it's nothing compared to when I used to wash all the dishes by hand. It's so convenient! I put my dishes in the morning, go to work, and they're all dry, even the door opens automatically. Even dinner time after work is so relaxing!

Sentence (English): I used to always buy the latest model when buying electronics, but as I've gotten older, maintenance is more important than the product itself.

After much deliberation, I decided to buy a dishwasher. I used to always buy the latest model when buying electronics, but as I've gotten older, maintenance is more important than the product itself. I was looking for something that was faithful to the basic functions, was affordable, and wouldn't stand out when installed in my kitchen. I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. My existing dishwasher was 12-person, so I thought it would only work with 12-person models. However, the 12-person and 14-person models are the same size, so they're compatible. They say electronics are a case of "bigger is better" and "smaller", so I figured if the external dimensions of a 12-person and 14-person model were the same, the internal space would be more usable. So, I chose the 12-person model. The white color was sold out, but since the upper and lower kitchen cabinet doors are over a decade old, the Nature Beige dishwasher blends in perfectly, just like the original built-in appliance. I think if I had installed it in white, my cabinets would have looked even more yellowish. The day after I purchased it, I received a KakaoTalk message confirming it was ready for installation, and the day after that, it was installed. Installation took about an hour and ten minutes. The installer was very thorough, ensuring the level was perfect, and I wondered if the installer should charge extra for the installation. Since we were removing the existing built-in appliance and installing the new one, there was no additional cost. I use powdered detergent, and I've seen reviews of dishwashers that mention residue on the dishes, so I was worried. But there's no such issue. The dishwasher is so clean and the dishes are shiny, and I'm happy with it. My husband was worried that the dishwasher would use a lot of water, but I told him that it uses so little water that even countries with water shortages recommend installing it. It's a top-rated energy-efficient product, so it doesn't use much electricity, and I even got a 10% rebate if I bought it at the end of December. I couldn't have asked for a better option. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute program, which includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since I have a small family, the 1 hour program is more than enough. For families with young children, the sterilization and high-temperature drying program would be incredibly helpful and reassuring. It's been less than a few days since I installed it, and I'm already able to load all my dishes and do other household chores. It's so convenient, I wish I hadn't been so stubborn and bought it sooner. I hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it's nothing compared to when I used to wash all the dishes by hand. It's so convenient! I put my dishes in the morning, go to work, and they're all dry, even the door opens automatically. Even dinner time after work is so relaxing!

After much deliberation, I decided to buy a dishwasher. I used to always buy the latest model when buying electronics, but as I've gotten older, maintenance is more important than the product itself. I was looking for something that was faithful to the basic functions, was affordable, and wouldn't stand out when installed in my kitchen. I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. My existing dishwasher was 12-person, so I thought it would only work with 12-person models. However, the 12-person and 14-person models are the same size, so they're compatible. They say electronics are a case of "bigger is better" and "smaller", so I figured if the external dimensions of a 12-person and 14-person model were the same, the internal space would be more usable. So, I chose the 12-person model. The white color was sold out, but since the upper and lower kitchen cabinet doors are over a decade old, the Nature Beige dishwasher blends in perfectly, just like the original built-in appliance. I think if I had installed it in white, my cabinets would have looked even more yellowish. The day after I purchased it, I received a KakaoTalk message confirming it was ready for installation, and the day after that, it was installed. Installation took about an hour and ten minutes. The installer was very thorough, ensuring the level was perfect, and I wondered if the installer should charge extra for the installation. Since we were removing the existing built-in appliance and installing the new one, there was no additional cost. I use powdered detergent, and I've seen reviews of dishwashers that mention residue on the dishes, so I was worried. But there's no such issue. The dishwasher is so clean and the dishes are shiny, and I'm happy with it. My husband was worried that the dishwasher would use a lot of water, but I told him that it uses so little water that even countries with water shortages recommend installing it. It's a top-rated energy-efficient product, so it doesn't use much electricity, and I even got a 10% rebate if I bought it at the end of December. I couldn't have asked for a better option. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute program, which includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since I have a small family, the 1 hour program is more than enough. For families with young children, the sterilization and high-temperature drying program would be incredibly helpful and reassuring. It's been less than a few days since I installed it, and I'm already able to load all my dishes and do other household chores. It's so convenient, I wish I hadn't been so stubborn and bought it sooner. I hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it's nothing compared to when I used to wash all the dishes by hand. It's so convenient! I put my dishes in the morning, go to work, and they're all dry, even the door opens automatically. Even dinner time after work is so relaxing!
Comments (Original): 집에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있었는데이 고장나서 주방용품을 넣어놓고 사용중이었는데 이제 아예 문이 안닫히는 지경에 이르러.. 고민 하다가 식기세척기를 구매하기로 했어요.  예전에는 전자제품을 사면 항상 최신형을 샀었는데 나이가 드니 .. 제품을 사는것보다 더 중요한게 유지보수더라구요.. 기본기능에 충실하면서 가격도 저렴하면서 우리집 주방에 설치했을 때 튀지 않는 제품을 고르다보니 선택하게 된게 LG DUE1BGLE제품이었어요.  기존에 설치되어 있던 제품이 12인용이라서 12인용만 설치 가능한줄 알았는데 12인용과 14인용은 크기가 같아서 호환이 되더라구요.  전자제품은 거거익선이라는데 12인용과 14인용 외형 치수가 같다면 내부는 활용하기 나름일 것 같다는 생각이 들어서 12인용으로 선택했어요. 색상도 화이이트는 품절이라 살 수도 없었지만 저희 집 주방 상하부장 문짝이 십수년된 화이트인지라 네이처베이지 식세기를 설치했더니 원래 설치된 빌트인 제품마냥 스며들어서 너무 자연스럽습니다. 아마 화이트로 설치했으면 우리집 상하부장이 더 누래보였을 것 같아요.. 구매하자 마자 바로 다음날 출발 카톡오고 다다음날 설치 완료 되었어요. 설치하는데는 약 1시간 10분정도 소요됐습니다. 수평도 잘 맞춰주시고 기사님이 설치비를 따로 받아야 하시는거 아닌가 하는 생각이 들 정도로 너무 고생해주셨는데 어쩃거나 저희집은 기존 빌트인제품 철거하고 새로 설치라 추가 비용이 들지는 않았습니다. 식세기는 가루 세제 사용하고 있는데 가루세제가 잔여물이 그릇에 붙어 있다는 식세기 후기들이 종종 보여서 걱정했는데  그런거 하나도 없이 너무 깨끗하고 그릇에서 광이 나고 저도 편하네요. 남편이 식세기 저렇게  돌아가면 물 많이 쓰는거 아니냐고 걱정하는데 물부족 국가에서 식세기 설치 하라고 할 정도로 물 적게 든다고 이야기해줬어요. 에너지 효율 1등급 제품이라 전기도 많이 들지 않고 12월 말에 구매해서 10프로 환급까지 받을 수 있어서 정말 이것보다 더 좋은 선택지는 없었던 것 같아요. 기사님은 살균에 고온건조까지 되는 1시간 50분짜리 코스가 좋다고 추천해주셨는데  저는 식구가 적어서 한시간 코스로도 충분한 것 같아요. 영유아 있는 집이라면 살균에 고온건조 코스까지  쓰면 너무 안심되고 좋을 것  같습니다. 설치한지 며칠 되지도 않았는데 식기 다 넣고 다른 집안일 할 수 있어서 시간 절약도 되고 너무 편해서 고집부리지 말고 조금 더 일찍 살걸 그랬다는 생각이 들어요. 식세기에 들어갈 수 없는 일부 식기들은 손설거지 하는데.. 예전에 전체 손설거지 할 때랑은 비교도 안됩니다. 정말 너무너무 편해요~  아침에 식기 넣어 놓고 출근하면 알아서 다 건조되서 문열림까지 되니까 퇴근 후에 저녁시간도 너무 여유로워요~

My existing dishwasher was 12-person, so I thought it would only work with 12-person models. However, the 12-person and 14-person models are the same size, so they're compatible. They say electronics are a case of "bigger is better" and "smaller", so I figured if the external dimensions of a 12-person and 14-person model were the same, the internal space would be more usable. I think if I had installed it in white, my cabinets would have looked even more yellowish. The installer was very thorough, ensuring the level was perfect, and I wondered if the installer should charge extra for the installation. Since we were removing the existing built-in appliance and installing the new one, there was no additional cost. My husband was worried that the dishwasher would use a lot of water, but I told him that it uses so little water that even countries with water shortages recommend installing it. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute program, which includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since I have a small family, the 1 hour program is more than enough. For families with young children, the sterilization and high-temperature drying program would be incredibly helpful and reassuring. After much deliberation, I decided to buy a dishwasher. I used to always buy the latest model when buying electronics, but as I've gotten older, maintenance is more important than the product itself. I was looking for something that was faithful to the basic functions, was affordable, and wouldn't stand out when installed in my kitchen. I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. My existing dishwasher was 12-person, so I thought it would only work with 12-person models. However, the 12-person and 14-person models are the same size, so they're compatible. They say electronics are a case of "bigger is better" and "smaller", so I figured if the external dimensions of a 12-person and 14-person model were the same, the internal space would be more usable. So, I chose the 12-person model. The white color was sold out, but since the upper and lower kitchen cabinet doors are over a decade old, the Nature Beige dishwasher blends in perfectly, just like the original built-in appliance. I think if I had installed it in white, my cabinets would have looked even more yellowish. The day after I purchased it, I received a KakaoTalk message confirming it was ready for installation, and the day after that, it was installed. Installation took about an hour and ten minutes. The installer was very thorough, ensuring the level was perfect, and I wondered if the installer should charge extra for the installation. Since we were removing the existing built-in appliance and installing the new one, there was no additional cost. I use powdered detergent, and I've seen reviews of dishwashers that mention residue on the dishes, so I was worried. But there's no such issue. The dishwasher is so clean and the dishes are shiny, and I'm happy with it. My husband was worried that the dishwasher would use a lot of water, but I told him that it uses so little water that even countries with water shortages recommend installing it. It's a top-rated energy-efficient product, so it doesn't use much electricity, and I even got a 10% rebate if I bought it at the end of December. I couldn't have asked for a better option. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute program, which includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since I have a small family, the 1 hour program is more than enough. For families with young children, the sterilization and high-temperature drying program would be incredibly helpful and reassuring. It's been less than a few days since I installed it, and I'm already able to load all my dishes and do other household chores. It's so convenient, I wish I hadn't been so stubborn and bought it sooner. I hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it's nothing compared to when I used to wash all the dishes by hand. It's so convenient! I put my dishes in the morning, go to work, and they're all dry, even the door opens automatically. Even dinner time after work is so relaxing!
Comments (Original): 집에 빌트인 식기세척기가 있었는데이 고장나서 주방용품을 넣어놓고 사용중이었는데 이제 아예 문이 안닫히는 지경에 이르러.. 고민 하다가 식기세척기를 구매하기로 했어요.  예전에는 전자제품을 사면 항상 최신형을 샀었는데 나이가 드니 .. 제품을 사는것보다 더 중요한게 유지보수더라구요.. 기본기능에 충실하면서 가격도 저렴하면서 우리집 주방에 설치했을 때 튀지 않는 제품을 고르다보니 선택하게 된게 LG DUE1BGLE제품이었어요.  기존에 설치되어 있던 제품이 12인용이라서 12인용만 설치 가능한줄 알았는데 12인용과 14인용은 크기가 같아서 호환이 되더라구요.  전자제품은 거거익선이라는데 12인용과 14인용 외형 치수가 같다면 내부는 활용하기 나름일 것 같다는 생각이 들어서 12인용으로 선택했어요. 색상도 화이이트는 품절이라 살 수도 없었지만 저희 집 주방 상하부장 문짝이 십수년된 화이트인지라 네이처베이지 식세기를 설치했더니 원래 설치된 빌트인 제품마냥 스며들어서 너무 자연스럽습니다. 아마 화이트로 설치했으면 우리집 상하부장이 더 누래보였을 것 같아요.. 구매하자 마자 바로 다음날 출발 카톡오고 다다음날 설치 완료 되었어요. 설치하는데는 약 1시간 10분정도 소요됐습니다. 수평도 잘 맞춰주시고 기사님이 설치비를 따로 받아야 하시는거 아닌가 하는 생각이 들 정도로 너무 고생해주셨는데 어쩃거나 저희집은 기존 빌트인제품 철거하고 새로 설치라 추가 비용이 들지는 않았습니다. 식세기는 가루 세제 사용하고 있는데 가루세제가 잔여물이 그릇에 붙어 있다는 식세기 후기들이 종종 보여서 걱정했는데  그런거 하나도 없이 너무 깨끗하고 그릇에서 광이 나고 저도 편하네요. 남편이 식세기 저렇게  돌아가면 물 많이 쓰는거 아니냐고 걱정하는데 물부족 국가에서 식세기 설치 하라고 할 정도로 물 적게 든다고 이야기해줬어요. 에너지 효율 1등급 제품이라 전기도 많이 들지 않고 12월 말에 구매해서 10프로 환급까지 받을 수 있어서 정말 이것보다 더 좋은 선택지는 없었던 것 같아요. 기사님은 살균에 고온건조까지 되는 1시간 50분짜리 코스가 좋다고 추천해주셨는데  저는 식구가 적어서 한시간 코스로도 충분한 것 같아요. 영유아 있는 집이라면 살균에 고온건조 코스까지  쓰면 너무 안심되고 좋을 것  같습니다. 설치한지 며칠 되지도 않았는데 식기 다 넣고 다른 집안일 할 수 있어서 시간 절약도 되고 너무 편해서 고집부리지 말고 조금 더 일찍 살걸 그랬다는 생각이 들어요. 식세기에 들어갈 수 없는 일부 식기들은 손설거지 하는데.. 예전에 전체 손설거지 할 때랑은 비교도 안됩니다. 정말 너무너무 편해요~  아침에 식기 넣어 놓고 출근하면 알아서 다 건조되서 문열림까지 되니까 퇴근 후에 저녁시간도 너무 여유로워요~

Sentence (English): The dishwasher is so clean and the dishes are shiny, and I'm happy with it.
Comments (English): I had a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I was using it to store kitchenware. Now, the door won't close at all. After much deliberation, I decided to buy a dishwasher. I used to always buy the latest model when buying electronics, but as I've gotten older, maintenance is more important than the product itself. I was looking for something that was faithful to the basic functions, was affordable, and wouldn't stand out when installed in my kitchen. I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. My existing dishwasher was 12-person, so I thought it would only work with 12-person models. However, the 12-person and 14-person models are the same size, so they're compatible. They say electronics are a case of "bigger is better" and "smaller", so I figured if the external dimensions of a 12-person and 14-person model were the same, the internal space would be more usable. So, I chose the 12-person model. The white color was sold out, but since the upper and lower kitchen cabinet doors are over a decade old, the Nature Beige dishwasher blends in perfectly, just like the original built-in appliance. I think if I had installed it in white, my cabinets would have looked even more yellowish. The day after I purchased it, I received a KakaoTalk message confirming it was ready for installation, and the day after that, it was installed. Installation took about an hour and ten minutes. The installer was very thorough, ensuring the level was perfect, and I wondered if the installer should charge extra for the installation. Since we were removing the existing built-in appliance and installing the new one, there was no additional cost. I use powdered detergent, and I've seen reviews of dishwashers that mention residue on the dishes, so I was worried. But there's no such issue. The dishwasher is so clean and the dishes are shiny, and I'm happy with it. My husband was worried that the dishwasher would use a lot of water, but I told him that it uses so little water that even countries with water shortages recommend installing it. It's a top-rated energy-efficient product, so it doesn't use much electricity, and I even got a 10% rebate if I bought it at the end of December. I couldn't have asked for a better option. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute program, which includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since I have a small family, the 1 hour program is more than enough. For families with young children, the sterilization and high-temperature drying program would be incredibly helpful and reassuring. It's been less than a few days since I installed it, and I'm already able to load all my dishes and do other household chores. It's so convenient, I wish I hadn't been so stubborn and bought it sooner. Comments (English): I had a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I was using it to store kitchenware. Now, the door won't close at all. After much deliberation, I decided to buy a dishwasher. I used to always buy the latest model when buying electronics, but as I've gotten older, maintenance is more important than the product itself. I was looking for something that was faithful to the basic functions, was affordable, and wouldn't stand out when installed in my kitchen. I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. My existing dishwasher was 12-person, so I thought it would only work with 12-person models. However, the 12-person and 14-person models are the same size, so they're compatible. They say electronics are a case of "bigger is better" and "smaller", so I figured if the external dimensions of a 12-person and 14-person model were the same, the internal space would be more usable. So, I chose the 12-person model. The white color was sold out, but since the upper and lower kitchen cabinet doors are over a decade old, the Nature Beige dishwasher blends in perfectly, just like the original built-in appliance. I think if I had installed it in white, my cabinets would have looked even more yellowish. The day after I purchased it, I received a KakaoTalk message confirming it was ready for installation, and the day after that, it was installed. Installation took about an hour and ten minutes. The installer was very thorough, ensuring the level was perfect, and I wondered if the installer should charge extra for the installation. Since we were removing the existing built-in appliance and installing the new one, there was no additional cost. I use powdered detergent, and I've seen reviews of dishwashers that mention residue on the dishes, so I was worried. But there's no such issue. The dishwasher is so clean and the dishes are shiny, and I'm happy with it. My husband was worried that the dishwasher would use a lot of water, but I told him that it uses so little water that even countries with water shortages recommend installing it. It's a top-rated energy-efficient product, so it doesn't use much electricity, and I even got a 10% rebate if I bought it at the end of December. I couldn't have asked for a better option. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute program, which includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since I have a small family, the 1 hour program is more than enough. For families with young children, the sterilization and high-temperature drying program would be incredibly helpful and reassuring. It's been less than a few days since I installed it, and I'm already able to load all my dishes and do other household chores. It's so convenient, I wish I hadn't been so stubborn and bought it sooner. I hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it's nothing compared to when I used to wash all the dishes by hand. It's so convenient! I put my dishes in the morning, go to work, and they're all dry, even the door opens automatically. Even dinner time after work is so relaxing!

My existing dishwasher was 12-person, so I thought it would only work with 12-person models. However, the 12-person and 14-person models are the same size, so they're compatible. They say electronics are a case of "bigger is better" and "smaller", so I figured if the external dimensions of a 12-person and 14-person model were the same, the internal space would be more usable. So, I chose the 12-person model. The white color was sold out, but since the upper and lower kitchen cabinet doors are over a decade old, the Nature Beige dishwasher blends in perfectly, just like the original built-in appliance. I think if I had installed it in white, my cabinets would have looked even more yellowish. The day after I purchased it, I received a KakaoTalk message confirming it was ready for installation, and the day after that, it was installed. Installation took about an hour and ten minutes. The installer was very thorough, ensuring the level was perfect, and I wondered if the installer should charge extra for the installation. Since we were removing the existing built-in appliance and installing the new one, there was no additional cost. I use powdered detergent, and I've seen reviews of dishwashers that mention residue on the dishes, so I was worried. But there's no such issue. The dishwasher is so clean and the dishes are shiny, and I'm happy with it. My husband was worried that the dishwasher would use a lot of water, but I told him that it uses so little water that even countries with water shortages recommend installing it. It's a top-rated energy-efficient product, so it doesn't use much electricity, and I even got a 10% rebate if I bought it at the end of December. I couldn't have asked for a better option. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute program, which includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since I have a small family, the 1 hour program is more than enough. For families with young children, the sterilization and high-temperature drying program would be incredibly helpful and reassuring. It's been less than a few days since I installed it, and I'm already able to load all my dishes and do other household chores. It's so convenient, I wish I hadn't been so stubborn and bought it sooner. I hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it's nothing compared to when I used to wash all the dishes by hand. It's so convenient! I put my dishes in the morning, go to work, and they're all dry, even the door opens automatically. Even dinner time after work is so relaxing!

Sentence (English): VERY disappointed with this Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): VERY disappointed with this Bosch dishwasher. The one plus is that it is VERY quiet. We have two dishwashers in our kitchen so I have a side-by-side comparison of this dishwasher and a 17 year old Bosch dishwasher. It is nowhere near as good as the old one. I've only run 5-6 loads in it and I've had to re-wash items from almost every one of those loads. The racking doesn't pull out or push back in smoothly; the configuration of the tines is over-complicated and keeps the racks from being more flexible in how/what you're loading into them; the silverware caddy is dinky and also hard to load/unload; the wire gauge used on the racks is thinner than the old dishwasher so it feels cheaper, and the third (top) rack, which I though I would love for washing our plastic lids also holds very little because of the "tine" configuration. Several of the wash options are only available through the app. I really wish we'd just spent the money to replace the broken control panel on the old Bosch dishwasher -- it is a MUCH BETTER machine.DEAR APPLIANCE MANUFACTURERS: Many consumers DO NOT WANT CONNECTED APPLIANCES. It's an overcomplication of computer power that is only going to lead to the appliance breaking down sooner.

Sentence (English): Bought this to replace a Whirlpool dishwasher from 2007.
Comments (English): [ Good, but needs improvement. ] || ---------------- || Bought this to replace a Whirlpool dishwasher from 2007. Soon after installing this dishwasher I noticed a small water leak at one side of the door seal. On further investigation, I noticed that the rack rails rub against and get caught on the door seal when pushing in the rack. I somewhat repaired the issue by removing the rack and rails and rearranging the rails and associated parts into a position where they rub less (but still contacting) the door seal. We need to pay close attention when using this dishwasher that the rails are not caught on the door seal before starting the dishwasher. I also noticed this dishwasher is equipped with a leak tray and sensor at the bottom of the appliance. I believe this isn't a necessary device if the dishwasher rails simply didn't interfere with door seals. We decided to keep the dishwasher, but might need to make more self-improvements to prevent any future leaks. Obviously, shouldn't need to do this for a new appliance.

Sentence (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Sentence (English): However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Sentence (English): In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Sentence (English): As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.
