Sentence (English): If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Sentence (English): It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Sentence (English): They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Sentence (English): I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Sentence (English): It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Sentence (English): Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Sentence (English): It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Sentence (English): I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Sentence (English): It is truly, truly convenient.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Sentence (English): I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.
Comments (English): We used to have a built-in dishwasher at home, but it broke down, so I had been using it just to store kitchenware. However, it has now reached the point where the door won't close at all. After much consideration, I decided to buy a new dishwasher. In the past, I always bought the latest models whenever I purchased electronics, but as I get older, I've realized that maintenance is more important than the purchase itself. I looked for a product that is faithful to basic functions, affordable, and wouldn't stand out in my kitchen, and that is how I ended up choosing the LG DUE1BGLE. Since the existing unit was a 12-place setting, I thought only the 12-place setting model could be installed, but it turns out the 12-place and 14-place setting models are the same size and therefore compatible. They say that with electronics, bigger is better, but since the exterior dimensions are the same for the 12-place and 14-place models, I figured the interior could be utilized however I wanted, so I chose the 12-place setting. (I looked it up and found that the 14-place setting model requires the upper shelf height to be about 5cm higher than the 12-place setting model and can be installed when the baseboard is 10cm. Those with 15cm baseboards will need to trim part of it.) As for the color, white was sold out so I couldn't buy it, but since the doors of my kitchen upper and lower cabinets are white and over a decade old, I installed the Nature Beige dishwasher. It blends in so naturally, looking just like the original built-in unit. If I had installed white, my cabinets probably would have looked even yellower. I received a KakaoTalk message saying it was shipped the very next day after purchase, and the installation was completed the day after that. It took about 1 hour and 10 minutes to install. They leveled it perfectly, and the technician worked so hard that I wondered if they should be charged a separate fee for the installation. However, since we removed the existing built-in unit and installed a new one, there were no additional costs. I use powder detergent, and I was worried because I often saw reviews mentioning that detergent residue sticks to the dishes. It is so clean without a single flaw, the dishes are shining, and it is so convenient for me. My husband was worried that the dishwasher might use a lot of water running like that, but I told him that it uses so little water that they recommend installing one in water-scarce countries. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency model, it doesn't consume much electricity, and because I bought it at the end of December and was able to receive a 10% cashback, I really don't think there was a better option than this. The technician recommended the 1 hour and 50 minute course that includes sterilization and high-temperature drying, but since my family is small, the 1-hour course seems sufficient for me. If you have infants or toddlers, I think using the sterilization and high-temperature drying course would be very reassuring and beneficial. It hasn't even been a few days since installation, but being able to put all the dishes in and do other housework saves time and is so convenient that I feel like I should have bought it a little earlier instead of being stubborn. I still hand-wash some dishes that don't fit in the dishwasher, but it is incomparable to when I used to hand-wash everything. It is truly, truly convenient. If I put the dishes in in the morning and go to work, they are all dried automatically and the door even opens for me. I have plenty of time for dinner after work, too.

Sentence (English): VERY disappointed with this Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): VERY disappointed with this Bosch dishwasher. The one plus is that it is VERY quiet. We have two dishwashers in our kitchen so I have a side-by-side comparison of this dishwasher and a 17 year old Bosch dishwasher. It is nowhere near as good as the old one. I've only run 5-6 loads in it and I've had to re-wash items from almost every one of those loads. Sentence (English): The appliance I've been most satisfied with in my home lately is undoubtedly my LG dishwasher.
Comments (English): The appliance I've been most satisfied with in my home lately is undoubtedly my LG dishwasher. I installed it about two months ago and have been using it every single day. I've definitely noticed a reduction in the time and physical strain I spend washing dishes, which has improved my quality of life. I'm a dual-income couple with two children, so washing dishes on weekday evenings and weekend lunches was always a huge stressor. It's no exaggeration to say that one of the reasons the days felt so long was the sheer volume of dishes. So, wanting to lighten the load on household chores, I compared several brands and settled on an LG dishwasher. From the first day of installation, I was amazed by its water usage and cleaning power. Initially, I was skeptical about whether an electric dishwasher could truly be cleaner than hand-washing. But when I put in greasy dishes, baby dishes, and even soup-stained dishes, they all came out clean, almost like they had just been boiled. The water pressure from the top and bottom of the dishwasher is so strong and consistent that it removes even the most stubborn stains. I couldn't help but wonder, "Why did I buy this now?" Another thing I liked was that it was surprisingly quiet. My living room is adjacent to the kitchen, and even when the dishwasher is running, it's not so noisy that I have to turn down the TV or interrupt conversations. It's especially quiet enough to run at night or early in the morning, making it much more convenient to run it right after a meal and then unload it the next morning. And the drying function! This was the most annoying part of hand washing, but this dishwasher automatically dries at high temperatures, so I don't have to wipe dishes with a dishcloth after each wash. The automatic door opening also helps remove moisture from the interior, reducing the risk of mold. Of course, there are a few drawbacks. The capacity is larger than expected, so I have to refill it frequently to be efficient. If you live alone, this might feel like a waste of water. While the initial installation and electricity costs are undeniable, considering the cost of water, detergent, and dishcloths, I think it actually saves money in the long run. Also, the results varied slightly depending on the detergent rinse aid I chose, so finding the right product required some initial trial and error. Nevertheless, the LG electric dishwasher provided me with a truly liberating experience from washing dishes. I can confidently say that this is a time-saving essential, especially for dual-income couples, families with children, and those who cook frequently. While the stress of washing dishes may seem like a minor part of life, it's actually a major daily chore. Since installing this product, I've found myself spending more time talking with my family or relaxing after dinner, free from the worry of washing dishes. If you're considering it, I highly recommend this appliance, it's well worth the investment.
Comments (Original): 최근 집안에서 가장 만족도가 높은 가전은 단연 LG 전기식기세척기입니다. 약 2개월 전부터 설치해 하루도 빠짐없이 사용하고 있는데, 설거지에 들이는 시간과 체력 부담이 확실히 줄면서 삶의 질이 올라간 걸 느낍니다.저는 맞벌이 부부이고 아이가 두 명이라 평일 저녁과 주말 점심 설거지가 늘 큰 스트레스였어요. 하루가 길게 느껴지는 이유 중 하나가 바로 “설거지 감당하기”였다고 해도 과언이 아닙니다. 그래서 집안일의 부담을 줄이고 싶어 여러 브랜드를 비교한 끝에 LG 전기식기세척기를 선택하게 됐습니다.설치 첫날부터 놀란 건 물 사용량과 세척력이었습니다. 초반에는 “전기식기세척기가 정말 손 설거지보다 깨끗할까?”라는 의구심이 있었는데, 실제로 기름때가 많은 접시와 유아용 식기, 국물 자국이 남은 그릇까지 넣고 돌리면 세척 후 거의 삶은 것 같은 깨끗함을 보여줬습니다. 특히 상단·하단에서 뿜어져 나오는 세척수압이 균일하고 강력해서 찌든 때까지 말끔하게 빠지는 걸 보면서 “이걸 왜 이제 샀지?”라는 생각이 절로 들었어요.또 하나 마음에 들었던 건 소음이 생각보다 낮다는 점입니다. 저희 집은 거실이 주방과 붙어 있는데, 세척기를 돌려도 TV 소리를 크게 줄이거나 대화를 멈출 만큼 시끄럽지 않아요. 특히 야간이나 새벽에 돌려도 부담 없는 수준이라, 식사 후 바로 돌려두고 다음 날 아침에 꺼내는 사용 패턴이 훨씬 편리합니다.그리고 건조 기능! 이건 손 설거지할 때 가장 귀찮았던 부분인데, 식기세척기에서는 자동으로 고온 건조까지 되니까 설거지 후 행주로 일일이 닦을 필요가 없어졌어요. 자동 문 열림으로 내부 습기까지 잘 빠져서 곰팡이 걱정도 덜합니다.물론 아쉬운 점도 조금 있습니다.용량이 생각보다 크다 보니 자주 가득 채워서 돌려야 효율적이에요. 혼자 사는 집이라면 오히려 물 낭비처럼 느낄 수도 있습니다.초기 설치비용과 전기세 걱정을 안 할 수는 없지만, 실제로 기존 물+세제+행주·수건 비용을 생각하면 장기적으로는 오히려 절약된다는 생각이 들었습니다.그리고 세제·린스 선택에 따라 결과물이 조금 달라져서, 가장 잘 맞는 제품을 찾는 데 초반 시행착오가 필요했어요.그럼에도 불구하고 LG 전기식기세척기는 “설거지에서 해방되는 경험”을 선사해 줬습니다. 특히 맞벌이 부부, 아이가 있는 가정, 요리를 자주 하는 집이라면 시간을 절약해 주는 생활 필수템이라고 자신 있게 말할 수 있어요.설거지 스트레스가 삶의 작은 부분 같지만, 실제로는 매일 반복되는 큰 노동입니다. 이 제품을 들여 놓은 후로 저는 저녁 식사 후 가족과 대화하거나 휴식을 취하는 시간이 늘었고, 설거지 걱정에서 자유로워졌습니다. 고민 중이라면 한 번쯤 투자할 만한 가치가 충분히 있는 가전이라고 추천합니다.

Sentence (English): I've definitely noticed a reduction in the time and physical strain I spend washing dishes, which has improved my quality of life.
Comments (English): The appliance I've been most satisfied with in my home lately is undoubtedly my LG dishwasher. I installed it about two months ago and have been using it every single day. I've definitely noticed a reduction in the time and physical strain I spend washing dishes, which has improved my quality of life. I'm a dual-income couple with two children, so washing dishes on weekday evenings and weekend lunches was always a huge stressor. It's no exaggeration to say that one of the reasons the days felt so long was the sheer volume of dishes. So, wanting to lighten the load on household chores, I compared several brands and settled on an LG dishwasher. From the first day of installation, I was amazed by its water usage and cleaning power. Initially, I was skeptical about whether an electric dishwasher could truly be cleaner than hand-washing. But when I put in greasy dishes, baby dishes, and even soup-stained dishes, they all came out clean, almost like they had just been boiled. The water pressure from the top and bottom of the dishwasher is so strong and consistent that it removes even the most stubborn stains. I couldn't help but wonder, "Why did I buy this now?" Another thing I liked was that it was surprisingly quiet. My living room is adjacent to the kitchen, and even when the dishwasher is running, it's not so noisy that I have to turn down the TV or interrupt conversations. It's especially quiet enough to run at night or early in the morning, making it much more convenient to run it right after a meal and then unload it the next morning. And the drying function! This was the most annoying part of hand washing, but this dishwasher automatically dries at high temperatures, so I don't have to wipe dishes with a dishcloth after each wash. The automatic door opening also helps remove moisture from the interior, reducing the risk of mold. Of course, there are a few drawbacks. The capacity is larger than expected, so I have to refill it frequently to be efficient. If you live alone, this might feel like a waste of water. While the initial installation and electricity costs are undeniable, considering the cost of water, detergent, and dishcloths, I think it actually saves money in the long run. Also, the results varied slightly depending on the detergent rinse aid I chose, so finding the right product required some initial trial and error. Nevertheless, the LG electric dishwasher provided me with a truly liberating experience from washing dishes. I can confidently say that this is a time-saving essential, especially for dual-income couples, families with children, and those who cook frequently. While the stress of washing dishes may seem like a minor part of life, it's actually a major daily chore. Since installing this product, I've found myself spending more time talking with my family or relaxing after dinner, free from the worry of washing dishes. If you're considering it, I highly recommend this appliance, it's well worth the investment.

Sentence (English): So, wanting to lighten the load on household chores, I compared several brands and settled on an LG dishwasher.
Comments (English): The appliance I've been most satisfied with in my home lately is undoubtedly my LG dishwasher. I installed it about two months ago and have been using it every single day. I've definitely noticed a reduction in the time and physical strain I spend washing dishes, which has improved my quality of life. I'm a dual-income couple with two children, so washing dishes on weekday evenings and weekend lunches was always a huge stressor. It's no exaggeration to say that one of the reasons the days felt so long was the sheer volume of dishes. So, wanting to lighten the load on household chores, I compared several brands and settled on an LG dishwasher. From the first day of installation, I was amazed by its water usage and cleaning power. Initially, I was skeptical about whether an electric dishwasher could truly be cleaner than hand-washing. But when I put in greasy dishes, baby dishes, and even soup-stained dishes, they all came out clean, almost like they had just been boiled. The water pressure from the top and bottom of the dishwasher is so strong and consistent that it removes even the most stubborn stains. I couldn't help but wonder, "Why did I buy this now?" Another thing I liked was that it was surprisingly quiet. My living room is adjacent to the kitchen, and even when the dishwasher is running, it's not so noisy that I have to turn down the TV or interrupt conversations. It's especially quiet enough to run at night or early in the morning, making it much more convenient to run it right after a meal and then unload it the next morning. And the drying function! This was the most annoying part of hand washing, but this dishwasher automatically dries at high temperatures, so I don't have to wipe dishes with a dishcloth after each wash. The automatic door opening also helps remove moisture from the interior, reducing the risk of mold. Of course, there are a few drawbacks. The capacity is larger than expected, so I have to refill it frequently to be efficient. If you live alone, this might feel like a waste of water. While the initial installation and electricity costs are undeniable, considering the cost of water, detergent, and dishcloths, I think it actually saves money in the long run. Also, the results varied slightly depending on the detergent rinse aid I chose, so finding the right product required some initial trial and error. Nevertheless, the LG electric dishwasher provided me with a truly liberating experience from washing dishes. I can confidently say that this is a time-saving essential, especially for dual-income couples, families with children, and those who cook frequently. While the stress of washing dishes may seem like a minor part of life, it's actually a major daily chore. Since installing this product, I've found myself spending more time talking with my family or relaxing after dinner, free from the worry of washing dishes. If you're considering it, I highly recommend this appliance, it's well worth the investment.

Comments (English): The appliance I've been most satisfied with in my home lately is undoubtedly my LG dishwasher. I installed it about two months ago and have been using it every single day. I've definitely noticed a reduction in the time and physical strain I spend washing dishes, which has improved my quality of life. I'm a dual-income couple with two children, so washing dishes on weekday evenings and weekend lunches was always a huge stressor. It's no exaggeration to say that one of the reasons the days felt so long was the sheer volume of dishes. So, wanting to lighten the load on household chores, I compared several brands and settled on an LG dishwasher. From the first day of installation, I was amazed by its water usage and cleaning power. Initially, I was skeptical about whether an electric dishwasher could truly be cleaner than hand-washing. But when I put in greasy dishes, baby dishes, and even soup-stained dishes, they all came out clean, almost like they had just been boiled. The water pressure from the top and bottom of the dishwasher is so strong and consistent that it removes even the most stubborn stains. I couldn't help but wonder, "Why did I buy this now?" Another thing I liked was that it was surprisingly quiet. My living room is adjacent to the kitchen, and even when the dishwasher is running, it's not so noisy that I have to turn down the TV or interrupt conversations. It's especially quiet enough to run at night or early in the morning, making it much more convenient to run it right after a meal and then unload it the next morning. And the drying function! If you're considering it, I highly recommend this appliance, it's well worth the investment.

So, wanting to lighten the load on household chores, I compared several brands and settled on an LG dishwasher. From the first day of installation, I was amazed by its water usage and cleaning power. Initially, I was skeptical about whether an electric dishwasher could truly be cleaner than hand-washing. But when I put in greasy dishes, baby dishes, and even soup-stained dishes, they all came out clean, almost like they had just been boiled. The water pressure from the top and bottom of the dishwasher is so strong and consistent that it removes even the most stubborn stains. I couldn't help but wonder, "Why did I buy this now?" Another thing I liked was that it was surprisingly quiet. My living room is adjacent to the kitchen, and even when the dishwasher is running, it's not so noisy that I have to turn down the TV or interrupt conversations. It's especially quiet enough to run at night or early in the morning, making it much more convenient to run it right after a meal and then unload it the next morning. And the drying function! This was the most annoying part of hand washing, but this dishwasher automatically dries at high temperatures, so I don't have to wipe dishes with a dishcloth after each wash. The automatic door opening also helps remove moisture from the interior, reducing the risk of mold. Of course, there are a few drawbacks. The capacity is larger than expected, so I have to refill it frequently to be efficient. If you live alone, this might feel like a waste of water. While the initial installation and electricity costs are undeniable, considering the cost of water, detergent, and dishcloths, I think it actually saves money in the long run. Also, the results varied slightly depending on the detergent rinse aid I chose, so finding the right product required some initial trial and error. Nevertheless, the LG electric dishwasher provided me with a truly liberating experience from washing dishes. I can confidently say that this is a time-saving essential, especially for dual-income couples, families with children, and those who cook frequently. While the stress of washing dishes may seem like a minor part of life, it's actually a major daily chore. Since installing this product, I've found myself spending more time talking with my family or relaxing after dinner, free from the worry of washing dishes. If you're considering it, I highly recommend this appliance, it's well worth the investment.

I'm a dual-income couple with two children, so washing dishes on weekday evenings and weekend lunches was always a huge stressor. It's no exaggeration to say that one of the reasons the days felt so long was the sheer volume of dishes. So, wanting to lighten the load on household chores, I compared several brands and settled on an LG dishwasher. From the first day of installation, I was amazed by its water usage and cleaning power. Initially, I was skeptical about whether an electric dishwasher could truly be cleaner than hand-washing. But when I put in greasy dishes, baby dishes, and even soup-stained dishes, they all came out clean, almost like they had just been boiled. The water pressure from the top and bottom of the dishwasher is so strong and consistent that it removes even the most stubborn stains. I couldn't help but wonder, "Why did I buy this now?" Another thing I liked was that it was surprisingly quiet. My living room is adjacent to the kitchen, and even when the dishwasher is running, it's not so noisy that I have to turn down the TV or interrupt conversations. It's especially quiet enough to run at night or early in the morning, making it much more convenient to run it right after a meal and then unload it the next morning. And the drying function! This was the most annoying part of hand washing, but this dishwasher automatically dries at high temperatures, so I don't have to wipe dishes with a dishcloth after each wash. The automatic door opening also helps remove moisture from the interior, reducing the risk of mold. Of course, there are a few drawbacks. The capacity is larger than expected, so I have to refill it frequently to be efficient. If you live alone, this might feel like a waste of water. While the initial installation and electricity costs are undeniable, considering the cost of water, detergent, and dishcloths, I think it actually saves money in the long run. Also, the results varied slightly depending on the detergent rinse aid I chose, so finding the right product required some initial trial and error. Nevertheless, the LG electric dishwasher provided me with a truly liberating experience from washing dishes. I can confidently say that this is a time-saving essential, especially for dual-income couples, families with children, and those who cook frequently. While the stress of washing dishes may seem like a minor part of life, it's actually a major daily chore. Since installing this product, I've found myself spending more time talking with my family or relaxing after dinner, free from the worry of washing dishes. If you're considering it, I highly recommend this appliance, it's well worth the investment.

Sentence (English): This LG dishwasher is pretty awesome and matches all of my other LG appliances perfectly!
Comments (English): [ Very quiet, looks good and cleans well ] || ---------------- || This LG dishwasher is pretty awesome and matches all of my other LG appliances perfectly! The first thing I noticed is how quiet it is! You can run it during dinner or while watching TV and barely hear it! The QuadWash system really does its job, as dishes come out clean even when they've been heavily used, and I rarely feel the need to prerinse anymore. The third rack is a nice for utensils and smaller items, and while the rack layout isn't the roomiest and takes a little time to get used to, it becomes manageable once you figure out the best way to load it with your particular items. The wash cycles are longer than my old dishwasher, but the tradeoff is better cleaning and water efficiency. Drying is decent, especially if you use rinse aid, though plastics can still hold some moisture when done. The stainless steel cleans up nicely with SS cleaner, and overall it feels like a well-built, solid dishwasher that is quiet and does a great job with quiet operation and consistent cleaning over quick cycle times. Installation was pretty standard and fit my space perfectly. It does have the WiFi feature, but I don't use it. I was also pleasantly surprised to see a light glow at the bottom when its running. Overall, im very happy with this LG dishwasher.

Sentence (English): The appliance I've been most satisfied with recently is definitely the LG dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ The most satisfying household item recently ] || ---------------- || The appliance I've been most satisfied with recently is definitely the LG dishwasher. I installed it about two months ago and have been using it every single day. I've definitely noticed a reduction in the time and physical strain I spend washing dishes, which has improved my quality of life. I'm a dual-income couple with two children, so washing dishes for weekday evenings and weekend lunches was always a huge stressor. It's no exaggeration to say that "handling the dishes" was one of the reasons the days felt so long. So, wanting to lighten the burden of household chores, I compared several brands and chose the LG dishwasher. From the first day of installation, I was amazed by its water usage and cleaning power. Initially, I was skeptical, wondering, "Is an electric dishwasher really cleaner than hand washing?" But when I put in my greasy dishes, baby dishes, and even soup-stained dishes, they all came out clean, almost like they had been boiled. Especially, the even and powerful water pressure from the top and bottom made it so easy to remove even the most stubborn stains. I couldn't help but think, "Why did I buy this now?" Another thing I liked was that it's surprisingly quiet. My living room is adjacent to the kitchen, and even when the dishwasher is running, it's not so loud that I have to turn down the TV or interrupt conversations. It's also quiet enough to run at night or early in the morning, making it much more convenient to run it right after a meal and take it out the next morning. And the drying function! This was the most annoying part of hand-washing dishes, but this dishwasher automatically dries at high temperatures, so I don't have to wipe them with a cloth after each wash. The automatic door opening also helps remove moisture from the interior, reducing the risk of mold. Of course, there are a few drawbacks. Because the capacity is larger than expected, I have to refill it frequently to be efficient. If you live alone, this might feel like a waste of water. While initial installation costs and electricity bills are certainly concerning, considering the cost of water, detergent, and dishcloths, I realized it actually saves money in the long run. Since the results varied slightly depending on the detergent and rinse aid chosen, finding the right product required some initial trial and error. Nevertheless, the LG dishwasher provided me with a truly "freeing from dishwashing." I can confidently say that it's a time-saving essential, especially for dual-income couples, families with children, and those who cook frequently. While the stress of washing dishes may seem like a minor part of life, it's actually a significant daily chore. Sentence (English): I installed it about two months ago and have been using it every single day.
Comments (English): [ The most satisfying household item recently ] || ---------------- || The appliance I've been most satisfied with recently is definitely the LG dishwasher. I installed it about two months ago and have been using it every single day. I've definitely noticed a reduction in the time and physical strain I spend washing dishes, which has improved my quality of life. I'm a dual-income couple with two children, so washing dishes for weekday evenings and weekend lunches was always a huge stressor. It's no exaggeration to say that "handling the dishes" was one of the reasons the days felt so long. So, wanting to lighten the burden of household chores, I compared several brands and chose the LG dishwasher. From the first day of installation, I was amazed by its water usage and cleaning power. Initially, I was skeptical, wondering, "Is an electric dishwasher really cleaner than hand washing?" But when I put in my greasy dishes, baby dishes, and even soup-stained dishes, they all came out clean, almost like they had been boiled. Especially, the even and powerful water pressure from the top and bottom made it so easy to remove even the most stubborn stains. I couldn't help but think, "Why did I buy this now?" Another thing I liked was that it's surprisingly quiet. My living room is adjacent to the kitchen, and even when the dishwasher is running, it's not so loud that I have to turn down the TV or interrupt conversations. It's also quiet enough to run at night or early in the morning, making it much more convenient to run it right after a meal and take it out the next morning. And the drying function! This was the most annoying part of hand-washing dishes, but this dishwasher automatically dries at high temperatures, so I don't have to wipe them with a cloth after each wash. The automatic door opening also helps remove moisture from the interior, reducing the risk of mold. Of course, there are a few drawbacks. Because the capacity is larger than expected, I have to refill it frequently to be efficient. If you live alone, this might feel like a waste of water. While initial installation costs and electricity bills are certainly concerning, considering the cost of water, detergent, and dishcloths, I realized it actually saves money in the long run. Since the results varied slightly depending on the detergent and rinse aid chosen, finding the right product required some initial trial and error. Nevertheless, the LG dishwasher provided me with a truly "freeing from dishwashing." I can confidently say that it's a time-saving essential, especially for dual-income couples, families with children, and those who cook frequently. While the stress of washing dishes may seem like a minor part of life, it's actually a significant daily chore. Since installing this product, I've found myself spending more time talking with my family or relaxing after dinner, and I've become free from the worry of washing dishes. If you're considering it, I highly recommend this appliance, it's well worth the investment.

Sentence (English): Initially, I was skeptical, wondering, "Is an electric dishwasher really cleaner than hand washing?"
Comments (English): [ The most satisfying household item recently ] || ---------------- || The appliance I've been most satisfied with recently is definitely the LG dishwasher. I installed it about two months ago and have been using it every single day. I've definitely noticed a reduction in the time and physical strain I spend washing dishes, which has improved my quality of life. I'm a dual-income couple with two children, so washing dishes for weekday evenings and weekend lunches was always a huge stressor. It's no exaggeration to say that "handling the dishes" was one of the reasons the days felt so long. So, wanting to lighten the burden of household chores, I compared several brands and chose the LG dishwasher. From the first day of installation, I was amazed by its water usage and cleaning power. Initially, I was skeptical, wondering, "Is an electric dishwasher really cleaner than hand washing?" But when I put in my greasy dishes, baby dishes, and even soup-stained dishes, they all came out clean, almost like they had been boiled. Especially, the even and powerful water pressure from the top and bottom made it so easy to remove even the most stubborn stains. I couldn't help but think, "Why did I buy this now?" Another thing I liked was that it's surprisingly quiet. My living room is adjacent to the kitchen, and even when the dishwasher is running, it's not so loud that I have to turn down the TV or interrupt conversations. It's also quiet enough to run at night or early in the morning, making it much more convenient to run it right after a meal and take it out the next morning. And the drying function! This was the most annoying part of hand-washing dishes, but this dishwasher automatically dries at high temperatures, so I don't have to wipe them with a cloth after each wash. The automatic door opening also helps remove moisture from the interior, reducing the risk of mold. Of course, there are a few drawbacks. Because the capacity is larger than expected, I have to refill it frequently to be efficient. If you live alone, this might feel like a waste of water. While initial installation costs and electricity bills are certainly concerning, considering the cost of water, detergent, and dishcloths, I realized it actually saves money in the long run. Since the results varied slightly depending on the detergent and rinse aid chosen, finding the right product required some initial trial and error. Nevertheless, the LG dishwasher provided me with a truly "freeing from dishwashing." I can confidently say that it's a time-saving essential, especially for dual-income couples, families with children, and those who cook frequently. While the stress of washing dishes may seem like a minor part of life, it's actually a significant daily chore. Since installing this product, I've found myself spending more time talking with my family or relaxing after dinner, and I've become free from the worry of washing dishes. If you're considering it, I highly recommend this appliance, it's well worth the investment.

Comments (English): [ The most satisfying household item recently ] || ---------------- || The appliance I've been most satisfied with recently is definitely the LG dishwasher. I installed it about two months ago and have been using it every single day. I've definitely noticed a reduction in the time and physical strain I spend washing dishes, which has improved my quality of life. I'm a dual-income couple with two children, so washing dishes for weekday evenings and weekend lunches was always a huge stressor. It's no exaggeration to say that "handling the dishes" was one of the reasons the days felt so long. So, wanting to lighten the burden of household chores, I compared several brands and chose the LG dishwasher. From the first day of installation, I was amazed by its water usage and cleaning power. Initially, I was skeptical, wondering, "Is an electric dishwasher really cleaner than hand washing?" But when I put in my greasy dishes, baby dishes, and even soup-stained dishes, they all came out clean, almost like they had been boiled. Especially, the even and powerful water pressure from the top and bottom made it so easy to remove even the most stubborn stains. I couldn't help but think, "Why did I buy this now?" Another thing I liked was that it's surprisingly quiet. My living room is adjacent to the kitchen, and even when the dishwasher is running, it's not so loud that I have to turn down the TV or interrupt conversations. This was the most annoying part of hand-washing dishes, but this dishwasher automatically dries at high temperatures, so I don't have to wipe them with a cloth after each wash. The automatic door opening also helps remove moisture from the interior, reducing the risk of mold. Of course, there are a few drawbacks. Because the capacity is larger than expected, I have to refill it frequently to be efficient. If you live alone, this might feel like a waste of water. While initial installation costs and electricity bills are certainly concerning, considering the cost of water, detergent, and dishcloths, I realized it actually saves money in the long run. Since the results varied slightly depending on the detergent and rinse aid chosen, finding the right product required some initial trial and error. Nevertheless, the LG dishwasher provided me with a truly "freeing from dishwashing." I can confidently say that it's a time-saving essential, especially for dual-income couples, families with children, and those who cook frequently. While the stress of washing dishes may seem like a minor part of life, it's actually a significant daily chore. Since installing this product, I've found myself spending more time talking with my family or relaxing after dinner, and I've become free from the worry of washing dishes. If you're considering it, I highly recommend this appliance, it's well worth the investment.

Sentence (English): We received this dishwasher as a gift when we bought our new house in August 2023.
Comments (English): [ A host of irritants, avoid this dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We received this dishwasher as a gift when we bought our new house in August 2023. Just a few months later, small cracks appeared along the sides of the door. The utensil basket is of appalling quality and durability: it's already broken in several places, constantly allowing utensils to fall through the bottom and obstructing the lower rack drawer. It's extremely irritating. The conveyor belt between the two racks frequently disconnects and falls out mid-cycle. It has to be manually reconnected very often. Furthermore, the upper rack drawer needs to be aligned with the conveyor belt for it to stay in place properly, and again, I often have to do this manually. This dishwasher is a major source of frustration in my daily life. Avoid it at all costs; it's rubbish.
Comments (Original): [ Un lot d’irritants, évitez ce lave-vaisselle ] || ---------------- || Nous nous sommes fait offrir ce lave-vaisselle en cadeau lors de l’achat de notre nouvelle maison en août 2023. Quelques mois à peine ont passé et de petites fentes se sont faites sur les côtés le long des côtés de la porte. Le panier pour ustensiles est d’une qualité et durabilité minables : il est déjà brisé à plusieurs endroits, laissant passer constamment plusieurs ustensiles à travers le fond, et obstruant le glissement du tiroir de l’étage inférieur. C’est extrêmement irritant. Le dispositif en hélice entre les deux étages se déconnecte fréquemment et tombe carrément en plein cycle. Il doit être reconnecté manuellement très souvent. D’ailleurs, le tiroir de l’étage supérieur doit s’aligner avec le dispositif en hélice pour que celui-ci tienne correctement, et encore une fois, je dois très souvent le faire manuellement. Ce lave-vaisselle est un irritant majeur dans ma vie de tous les jours. À éviter absolument, c’est une cochonnerie.

Sentence (English): Overall, I'm happy with the Bosch 300 Series dishwasher and would recommend it, especially for homeowners who prefer a DIY-friendly installation.
Comments (English): [ Solid performance with minor design drawbacks ] || ---------------- || Overall, I'm happy with the Bosch 300 Series dishwasher and would recommend it, especially for homeowners who prefer a DIY-friendly installation. The install process was straightforward and easy to handle without professional help. One of my favorite features is the third rack for utensils, which is a great use of space and frees up much more room in the lower racks for plates, bowls, and larger items. The dishwasher also integrates with the Bosch app, which is convenient for starting and monitoring cycles remotely. I really like the display panel that shows how much time is left in the cycle, and for the most part, it cleans dishes very well. Not to mention the machine runs very quiet, which is a big plus for people like me who likes to run it before going to bed. That said, there are a few drawbacks. The rubber padding on the sides could be wider, as it doesn't fully cover the mounting brackets used to secure the unit to the cabinets. After a cycle finishes, the clean indicator turns off too quickly, making it hard for other people in the household to know whether the dishes are clean. I also wish the door would stay slightly open for air drying after a wash—this isn't supported. Lastly, while general cleaning performance is good, it struggles with coffee stains on mugs unless they're pre-rinsed.

You may end up like me—doing the work yourself and wondering why you paid for installation and haul-away in the first place.

Sentence (English): I wish I could resurrect this machine.
Comments (English): [ Motor died after 3 years ] || ---------------- || I wish I could resurrect this machine. For the time we had it, 5 stars, everything was great. Not even 4 years old, and the motor died. Paid a repair man $130 to tell us to replace it. That's why I can only give 1 star. I loved everything about this dishwasher, but 3 years is simply unacceptable for a $500+ appliance. These should not be disposable products! Loved the silverware rack at the top, that's why we got it. Pretty quiet, never bothered us. Using the extra hot setting on any cycle, it actually did get dishes completely dry. Never had any issues with residue, never even had a mechanical issue before it died. That makes it extra disappointing.Only thing was that a spot on the second rack did start rusting in less than a year, gradually spread. Also a few of the teeth on the silverware top rack started breaking after 2 years, but that seemed like relatively normal wear and tear. That and the toddler-aged motor crapping out. We're just a two person, one dog household; the capacity was perfect for us. We normally ran about 2 loads every 3 days, not quite one each day. I could see a larger family having trouble with multiple loads a day. The front facing control panel always worked well and had a setting for everything we needed. Usually I just used express in high heat; the normal cycle helped with large loads. (Granted, I do thoroughly rinse dishes before loading them.)No more LG appliances for us--unless they want to focus on longevity, then we'd gladly return.

The appliance is fairly quiet, and the dishes come out very clean, with efficient drying. I particularly like the third basket, which is very practical for organizing utensils. However, some design details disappoint me. The finish on the baskets isn't ideal: the mesh of the bottom basket doesn't hold some lids well, which tend to protrude downwards and can easily block the spray arm just below. The roller-based sliding mechanism of this same basket also lacks stability and sometimes tips over when I pull it out. Finally, the red LED light projected onto the floor during cycles, which is supposed to be helpful, seemed too blurry and harsh. I ended up turning it off via the app; thankfully, that's possible.
Comments (Original): [ Bon appareil pour le prix ] || ---------------- || [Cet avis a été recueilli dans le cadre d’une promotion.] J’ai acheté un lave‑vaisselle Bosch de la série 100 en ligne, et globalement j’en suis satisfait. J’aime particulièrement le troisième panier, qui est très pratique pour organiser les ustensiles.En revanche, certains détails de conception me déçoivent. La finition des paniers n’est pas idéale : le grillage du panier du bas retient mal certains couvercles, qui ont tendance à dépasser vers le bas et peuvent facilement bloquer l’hélice située juste en dessous. Le mécanisme de glissement à roulettes de ce même panier manque aussi de stabilité et il lui arrive de basculer quand je le tire.Enfin, l’ampoule LED rouge projetée au sol pendant les cycles, censée être utile, m’a paru trop floue et grossière. Je l’ai finalement désactivée via l’application, heureusement c’est possible.
