Sentence (English): I wish I could resurrect this machine.
Comments (English): [ Motor died after 3 years ] || ---------------- || I wish I could resurrect this machine. For the time we had it, 5 stars, everything was great. Not even 4 years old, and the motor died. Paid a repair man $130 to tell us to replace it. That's why I can only give 1 star. I loved everything about this dishwasher, but 3 years is simply unacceptable for a $500+ appliance. These should not be disposable products! Loved the silverware rack at the top, that's why we got it. Pretty quiet, never bothered us. Using the extra hot setting on any cycle, it actually did get dishes completely dry. Never had any issues with residue, never even had a mechanical issue before it died. That makes it extra disappointing. Only thing was that a spot on the second rack did start rusting in less than a year, gradually spread. Also a few of the teeth on the silverware top rack started breaking after 2 years, but that seemed like relatively normal wear and tear. That and the toddler-aged motor crapping out. We're just a two person, one dog household; the capacity was perfect for us. We normally ran about 2 loads every 3 days, not quite one each day. I could see a larger family having trouble with multiple loads a day. The front facing control panel always worked well and had a setting for everything we needed. Usually I just used express in high heat; the normal cycle helped with large loads. (Granted, I do thoroughly rinse dishes before loading them.). No more LG appliances for us--unless they want to focus on longevity, then we'd gladly return.

Sentence (English): I looked into a six-person dishwasher and chose one because the price difference wasn't that big compared to a built-in one, and I'm glad I did.
Comments (English): I looked into a six-person dishwasher and chose one because the price difference wasn't that big compared to a built-in one, and I'm glad I did. Frying pans take up a lot of space when I put them in the dishwasher, which makes me realize I made the right choice every time I see one. However, as a family of two, I don't use the dishwasher all the time. The two-hour wash cycle is a bit burdensome, but when I have a small amount of dishes, there's a shorter one-hour cycle, so I use it often. Another advantage is that I don't have to sterilize dishes and cutlery separately in boiling water. And it looks neater because I don't have to keep a separate dish dryer on the sink. In any case, I think I made a good purchase with this dishwasher, which relieves me of the daily dishwashing chores.
Comments (Original): 6인용 식기세척기 알아보다 빌트인과 가격 차이가 그다지 크지 않아서 선택했는데 잘했다는 생각이 듭니다. 프라이팬을 식세기에 넣을 때 공간을 많이 차지 하는데 그걸 보고 빌트인 선택하길 잘했다고 매번 느낍니다. 하지만 2인 가족으로 매번 식세기 이용은 잘 안되더라구요. 2시간 정도 소요되는 세척시간이 부담스러운 것도 하나의 이유이기도 합니다. 하지만 설거지 양이 적을 때는 1시간 짧은 코스도 있어서 자주 이용합니다. 그릇과 수저를 끓는 물에 따로 소독하지 않아도 된다는 점도 장점이네요. 그리고 싱크대 위에 그릇 건조기를 따로 두지 않아도 되어서 깔끔해보이는 것도 좋아요.아무튼 매일 하루에 몇번씩 해야하는 설거지에서  일정부분 해방시켜주는 식세기를 잘 구입했다 생각합니다.

I always add the high-temperature sterilization and high-power dryer, and it takes about 1 hour and 30 minutes. Without the high-power dryer, the standard mode takes about 1 hour and 10 minutes. I don't have children but if I did, this would worry me. Once the dishwasher cycle is completed it actually pops open the door about 2 inches. This allows more of the steam to escape and is part of the drying cycle. There is metal vinyl contact paper located in the user manual bag that needs to be installed for this little feature so the steam doesn't ruin the underside of the countertop. There is a optional setting to keep the door closed, which I set up. I'm just looking for the hot water and detergent to disinfect them. I had made tacos and the meat was in a plastic bowl. For perspective, I have only washed around a dozen loads since purchasing in late December which does not really qualify for a fair review. Our former Bosch D/W was put together like a tank, and it was quiet running. But the cost of replacing with a similar Bosch model was too much money to justify. The LG machine does a good job of cleaning and drying, However, the racks and assembly are not sturdy, and I do not have much confidence that it will last as long as our Bosch. When a loan has been completed, and the temperature has sufficiently cooled, the door will pop open. I don't know if I like that feature or not, but I am mentioning it just in case it matters to anyone. In summary the LG gets the job done but has inferior build quality. I'm hoping for the best.

Comments (English): [ Major Failure After Only 110 Days of Use ] || ---------------- || Previously owned a Samsung dishwasher that cost around $700 and worked reliably for about seven years. When it finally failed, I decided to upgrade to what I believed would be a higher-quality, premium option. These additional requirements resulted in extra costs. The installer left, and I had to hire a third-party technician to complete the installation.After about 110 days of use, the dishwasher stopped functioning properly. Water remained inside the unit and would not drain. After researching the issue, I learned that a drain pump failure is a known issue reported by other customers as well.Because I was slightly beyond Costco's return period, I was referred to Bosch customer support. Bosch scheduled a service appointment approximately one and a half weeks later to diagnose the issue, and I was informed that additional time might be required if replacement parts are needed.Spending this amount of money on a product positioned as premium, only to encounter installation complications and a major failure within a few months, has been very disappointing. The ongoing wait for service and potential parts has made this experience especially frustrating.Based on this experience, I have personally decided that I will never purchase Bosch appliances from Costco again.

This has become a recurring issue with buying items open box from Best Buy. I asked them if they thought it made sense for me to uninstall the dishwasher and then bring it back to the store instead of just sending me the missing parts because I had a warranty on it and I was told no, that I had to physically just return it as if it was a 5lb item. Just zero care and concern for what I was mislead to believe. I've spent thousands of dollars a year with Best Buy but who cares right? It's really sad because this used to be one of my favorite stores to shop at but I'll be checking out the competition going forward.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is nice, it does a good job washing.
Comments (English): [ Open door drying is not a good idea ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is nice, it does a good job washing. I don't think the installer that I paid for through Lowe's installed it according to instructions so that is very frustrating and they would not return my call when I had questions. They were not accommodating with other appointment times either. Didn't have a great experience there. The instruction say the dishwasher is supposed to be installed with a protective tape on the bottom of the counter top and sides of cabinets to protect from moisture when the dishwasher door automatically opens for the drying process. The installer did NOT do that. I don't know where the tape is. I'm assuming they threw it away with the box. I let the machine do the open door drying cycle one time to see how it went. Everything around the door (bottom of counter and side of cabinet (to one side is a bump out) was dripping wet. Steam is really hot so over time this would certainly damage our cabinets and maybe our counter top. I don't know how this could be considered a good idea. Installer also did not push the dishwasher into the opening far enough so there is an ugly black rubber seal sticking out over my white cabinets. And he didn't raise the dishwasher enough so there was a gap between the top of the dishwasher and the counter. So installer was not concerned with how it looked or protecting my cabinets/counter and the open door drying function just seems like. Headache waiting to happen. As for the dishwashing, it is good. I like the lights in the tub and the third rack. Lots of space and easy to raise and lower the 2nd rack (easier when it's empty). I have turned off the open door function and I let it cool inside and then crack the door when the steam won't get everything around the dishwasher soaking wet. It will still do the job fine, but those are my frustrations with the installer and the function of the machine itself.

Comments (English): [ First impressions ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) I'm very happy with this purchase. It's a well built dishwasher that feels solid and cleans dishes well. Installation was relatively easy but the instructions were better designed for an installer than a homeowner. Obviously, it is smaller but the 3 setting for the middle rack give options. That said if you're washing 12 inch plates you have to use the highest set point and that limits what you can load in the middle. The top third rack works well for silverwear and can fit very small bowls -- but I wish it was simpler as all the slots limit it use to that. A great machine for a single person or a couple with a smaller kitchen.

Sentence (English): We purchased our Bosch 500 about 3 months ago (after thorough research) because we wanted to replace the old (stinky) dishwasher that came with our new home, and it has perfectly met our needs so far.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 500 (SHP65CM5N) Review ] || ---------------- || We purchased our Bosch 500 about 3 months ago (after thorough research) because we wanted to replace the old (stinky) dishwasher that came with our new home, and it has perfectly met our needs so far. The "Home Connect" app is easy to use (the ability to customize/program your washes is nice) as well as the touch panel on top. As for its size, the adjustable racks and moveable utensil caddy provide plenty of room for our cups, bowls, pans, plates, trays, etc. The dishwasher is mostly silent while in use and, for the most part, everything comes out clean. Even with rinse aid, we've noticed occasional streaking, and sometimes dishes will need an additional wash/handwashed if they're especially dirty (saves time from scrubbing at least). If you use the app, you can also monitor the progress of your wash and review your monthly statistics. Overall, we are happy with Bosch and look forward to many years of use.

Sentence (English): Reviews were hit and miss, but in terms of bang for buck with was a good option to replaced our deceased Samsung.
Comments (English): [ Overall pretty great product. ] || ---------------- || Reviews were hit and miss, but in terms of bang for buck with was a good option to replaced our deceased Samsung. Firstly I do like the colour on the exterior, its plastic not stainless, but it still looks good. The buttons are easy to use and make sense though for someone of my years the writing could be a little larger, clearer or both. Thankfully I rarely have to stand and squint at the machine because I can do it all via the app, i feel like a hipster millennial all of a sudden! The racks are a bit cheap in both design and quality, and the height adjust is a real faff of a thing, but it works just fine, one you figure out what goes where its simple and does the job well. The upper rack has no adjustable tines, the lower rack has them but only at the back, and i can't quite figure out the free range cuttlery basket that just sits there, but again, what it lacks in form or design it makes up for in result. I mostly do either a 60 min cycle or a 'medium' with +drying, both give excellent cleaning results across a range of items from glassware to bowls to pots and pans. Its been about a month almost and i'm more than happy with it at this stage, it will be interesting to see how long that remains true, I suspect it wont be as robust as its predecessor which lasted nearly exactly ten years, but in terms of quality of what its doing, and the ease including the app, i'd say machine is pretty great. One thing I do not love however is that it is noisy, its partly because its not fully enclosed under a bench but has somewhat exposed sides meaning noise that might otherwise be absored by shelves is escaping, but it is not nearly as quiet as claimed. But who cares about that I guess. overall it is a great value product and the cleaning results using fairly standard tablet/capsule things is excellent and that is its fundamental job.

Sentence (English): If you were to list one kitchen essential, a dishwasher is a must-have.
Comments (English): [ exorcism ] || ---------------- || If you were to list one kitchen essential, a dishwasher is a must-have. So after much deliberation, I chose the Samsung Bespoke dishwasher. After using it for a few days, I could clearly see why everyone was talking about Bespoke. The first thing that struck me when I first opened the door after installing it was the interior storage structure and the perfect design. The baskets didn't wobble, and the layout was well-organized to neatly store dishes large and small, which gave me high expectations even before using it. True to the Bespoke line, the exterior is clean and luxurious, which definitely changes the kitchen atmosphere. The absence of protruding handles adds a nice touch of cleanliness. In practice, I was most impressed by the cleaning performance. The "AI Customized Cleaning" feature automatically adjusts the water temperature and spray intensity based on the level of food contamination. This isn't just advertising; it's real. Even greasy dishes and burnt-on pots are almost brand new after each cycle. Compared to my old dishwasher, the cycle length isn't significantly longer, which improves efficiency. Best of all, it's quiet, so I can run it at night without any problems. Another unexpectedly convenient feature was the auto-open function. After the wash is done, the door automatically opens to release the internal heat, significantly improving the drying speed and drying quality. My old dishwasher required me to open the door, and if I forgot, moisture would remain inside, but this one is automatic, making it completely convenient. The hot air dryer dries the dishes thoroughly, leaving no water marks and allowing me to put them away right away. The convenience features were also a real surprise. It syncs with the smartphone app, allowing me to check the washing progress and start or pause the dishwasher even when I'm out and about, making my life much more convenient. It even supports Bixby voice control, so even when I'm busy or cooking, I can simply tell it to start the dishwasher. The only downside is that it's a bit pricey, considering it's a premium model. But honestly, after using it a few times, I feel it's worth it, and I don't regret it too much. More than anything, it saves me a ton of time in the kitchen, and the satisfaction of having the dishes come out clean every time makes my life feel better with just one appliance. Sentence (English): Dishwashers, often called the "Three Great Electronics Aunts," are far more useful in everyday life than washing machines.

Washing dishes used to be a constant source of water splashing and numbness, but now all I have to do is press a button, which has significantly reduced my daily stress. I'm also very satisfied with the dishwasher's performance. Even grease and stuck-on food are thoroughly removed on the high-power mode. The various trays and compartments are well-designed to prevent cups, plates, and cutlery from colliding with each other, making cleanup a breeze. I especially appreciate the high-temperature drying function, which allows me to store my dishes dry immediately after washing. The clean design and intuitive buttons make it easy for anyone, regardless of age or gender, to use. It's also quieter than I expected, so I don't feel uncomfortable even running it in the evening. The only downside is the need for regular cleaning of the water-scaling filter. (But that's a common problem with most dishwashers.) Overall, this is the perfect example of a dishwasher that you can't go back to once you've used it. I highly recommend it if you want to save time on dishwashing in your busy life.

Comments (English): [ The Gold Standard of LG Dishwashers ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is top-notch; it cleans and dries our dishes very well. The steam adds an extra boost to the cleaning ability, and the lighting—although simple—elevates the experience and makes loading dishes more pleasant. The regular model was trash; a part would fail every few months, causing an error code and making the unit cease to function. However, the last two upper-tier models have worked flawlessly. My daughter even flooded one because she used regular dish soap instead of dishwasher detergent. While it threw errors for a few days, once it dried out, it went back to working normally. Overall, I am very happy with this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I recently got a dishwasher.
Comments (English): I recently got a dishwasher. I'd always thought I didn't need one, but it turned out to be a good thing because my husband helped me out. Lately, both of us have gotten so busy that we haven't been able to do much housework. The washer and dryer do the laundry, but the dishes just pile up. I thought I couldn't take it anymore, but then the algorithm led me to a countertop dishwasher. The moment I saw it, I knew it was perfect for my home and bought it. Customer review: Just place it on the kitchen counter and you're done! Our kitchen is small, so we didn't have a good spot for a dishwasher. While it's possible to squeeze a shelf under the induction stove, it's a bit inconvenient to move around, and I didn't like it. It also takes up too much storage space. Then, when I saw this countertop dishwasher, I knew it was the one and bought it right away. It claims to be able to handle six servings of dishes, but it's perfect for our family of three. I like to wash my dishes multiple times, as needed, but I was hesitant about buying a dishwasher because I didn't want to run it multiple times in a large dishwasher. This one is small enough to handle multiple washes without feeling cumbersome. I like that I can wash dishes as needed. Its small size doesn't diminish its cleaning power. It washes dishes really well. Cups and other dishes that only need a quick wash are cleaned quickly and thoroughly in just 30 minutes, making it easy to run. The auto-opening feature prevents moisture and stains from forming. I also like that the door opens and dries before I go out. The clean design and colors make it look neat and tidy on the kitchen counter. It's also quiet, so I think I can run it in the evenings. While it won't wash the large pots and pans I use at home, it's completely freeing for dishes and cups. I hope my review was helpful to anyone considering a purchase. (**)

Sentence (English): This review is based on my careful selection and actual use of the dishwasher, outlining its pros and cons.
Comments (English): [ It's so convenient ] || ---------------- || This review is based on my careful selection and actual use of the dishwasher, outlining its pros and cons. I'm writing this review the day before the deadline. I've been using it for a while and am leaving a sincere review. << LG Electronics Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 14-Person >>. It really cleared my head! Similar! Released around the same time, the specs are slightly different. My selection criteria were: 1. Hot air drying. I don't need to use it every time, but I can use it when needed. 2. The touch control panel must be on the front. It must be selectable from the outside even when the lid is closed. 3. It must be 14-person. If I'm going to buy it anyway, I'd rather have it hold a lot. I've been using it for a few months now. I don't use the hot air drying feature every time I run the dishwasher; I can let it air dry and it's completely dry. Since the hot air drying time is long, I only use it when necessary. I'm really satisfied with the touch control panel on the front. Among other dishwasher products, those with touch controls above the lid, when the lid is closed, require you to open the door while it's running! Of course, you can open the door, but I personally really like the fact that I can check the operation with my eyes and even touch the door with it closed. Some dishwashers have lights inside, but I don't really need them. When I open the door, I can see everything inside. If I turn on the kitchen lights, the inside is pitch black, so I can't see anything. Since I slide the basket out to put dishes in and take them out anyway, I didn't need it! Voice recognition. Since my phone is connected to the app anyway, I didn't need it! Of course, it's more convenient with features—perhaps even more so. But it's still easy to use without them, and the more features, the higher the price of the dishwasher. I'm completely satisfied with it! If you use it before the first use, the dishwasher smells less and the cleaning cycle is longer. It's great. Rating: (5/5). I hope my review was helpful ^^. Please hold down the helpful button. Thank you~~

Sentence (English): I replaced our old Whirlpool Dishwasher with a very simular one.
Comments (English): I replaced our old Whirlpool Dishwasher with a very simular one. The 2 gentlemen who delivered and installed it were very professional and we were very pleased. My problem came a day later when I opend the dishwasher and some disher were still not really dry. But then I saw water in the bottom right by the dorr and in the center part. I thought I might have set something wrong and paid extra attention next time also set it on extra drying. It made no difference.Then I contacted the seller and they asked for photos, which I sent to them and they arranged a service man to come. He also was very professional and checked everything closely. The told me that it all works well and he can't find a problem and that all the new models will do that since the are now made with rubberized material to keep from rusting. He understands it's annoying, but maybe I could open the door right after it finished the cycle to let it all dry out then made a couple small adjustments and apologized. As I said, he was very nice and understnding. So, ultimately I am stuck with the puddles of water. It makes me sad and I regret not checking out other brands before I purchased Whirlpool. Elke Rosemann Bader

They only had the model I wanted in stainless steel. They told me they'd have to special order the black that I needed and it wasn't at the sales price. The higher price was more than I'd budgeted for so I asked the salesman for a comparison with a lesser model. After it was installed I discovered that this model didn't have a rinse and hold feature. I was very disappointed to discover that since I used that cycle every day with my previous model. My husband and I are the only ones in our household so we only run a full load once a day. Later I read that the model I purchased doesn't have the rinse and hold feature so I'd have to start a wash cycle and then turn it off after the first rinse. This is very inconvenient. I wouldn't have purchased this dishwasher if I'd known that. I was upset that I had to pay more for a lesser model just because it wasn't stainless steel.

Sentence (English): We bought a Maytag dishwasher expecting it to last a decade.
Comments (English): [ Circulation Pump Self-Destructed at 3 Years – Not a Clog, a Design Failure ] || ---------------- || We bought a Maytag dishwasher expecting it to last a decade. It failed completely after only 3 years of normal household use (4–5 loads per week).Symptoms were strange: the dishwasher still filled with water and heated normally, but the spray arms stopped turning and dishes came out dirty.I removed the circulation pump assembly myself and discovered the real cause: the stainless diffuser sleeve inside the pump had been physically crushed inward, with melted seal material embedded in it. This was not food debris and not a simple clog — the pump bearing failed, the shaft went off-axis, and the rotating impeller literally destroyed the pump from the inside.This is not wear-and-tear. This is a mechanical collapse of a critical component far earlier than its expected service life. Based on usage, the pump lasted roughly 600–700 cycles. Comparable dishwashers historically last several thousand cycles.The most frustrating part: Maytag's “10-year limited warranty” does not cover the circulation pump or motor — only racks, tub liner, and chopper blade. So a catastrophic failure of the main wash motor is treated as out-of-warranty after just one year.We were forced to replace the dishwasher instead of repairing it because the pump is a sealed assembly that costs more to replace than the value of the machine.If you are considering this brand, understand that a dishwasher can appear to work normally — heating and filling — while producing zero wash pressure, and the warranty will not protect you when the pump self-destructs.This experience changed how I evaluate appliance warranties forever.

Sentence (English): We bought a Maytag dishwasher expecting it to last a decade.
Comments (English): [ Circulation Pump Self-Destructed at 3 Years – Not a Clog, a Design Failure ] || ---------------- || We bought a Maytag dishwasher expecting it to last a decade. It failed completely after only 3 years of normal household use (4–5 loads per week). Symptoms were strange: the dishwasher still filled with water and heated normally, but the spray arms stopped turning and dishes came out dirty. I removed the circulation pump assembly myself and discovered the real cause: the stainless diffuser sleeve inside the pump had been physically crushed inward, with melted seal material embedded in it. This was not food debris and not a simple clog — the pump bearing failed, the shaft went off-axis, and the rotating impeller literally destroyed the pump from the inside. This is not wear-and-tear. This is a mechanical collapse of a critical component far earlier than its expected service life. Based on usage, the pump lasted roughly 600–700 cycles. Comparable dishwashers historically last several thousand cycles. The most frustrating part: Maytag's “10-year limited warranty” does not cover the circulation pump or motor — only racks, tub liner, and chopper blade. So a catastrophic failure of the main wash motor is treated as out-of-warranty after just one year. We were forced to replace the dishwasher instead of repairing it because the pump is a sealed assembly that costs more to replace than the value of the machine. If you are considering this brand, understand that a dishwasher can appear to work normally — heating and filling — while producing zero wash pressure, and the warranty will not protect you when the pump self-destructs. This experience changed how I evaluate appliance warranties forever.
